Billing period doesn't match fee 422 VALIDATION_FAILED "Yearly plans must use a yearly period."
Effective date in the past / > 1 year 422 VALIDATION_FAILED "Pick a time from now up to one year ahead."
Price change > 50 % without confirmation 422 VALIDATION_FAILED "This is a {x}% change. Confirm it's intended."
Publishing with no draft 409 CONFLICT_STATE "There's no draft to publish."
Scheduling when one is already scheduled 409 CONFLICT_STATE "Cancel the change scheduled for {date} first."
Concurrent publish (unique index violation) 409 VERSION_CONFLICT "Someone published a change just now. Reload."
Cancelling a non-scheduled version 409 CONFLICT_STATE "Only scheduled changes can be cancelled."
Draft edited elsewhere 409 VERSION_CONFLICT "This draft changed in another tab."
Missing reason 422 VALIDATION_FAILED "Add a reason."

21. Future Scalability Notes & Enhancements

  • City- or segment-specific pricing: add scope jsonb (city_ids, user_type) and resolve the most specific active version.
  • Promo codes and coupons as a separate module referencing fee codes.
  • A/B price tests (split by user id hash) with experiment ids stored on transactions.
  • Multi-currency when expanding beyond India (currency per version already stored).

22. Security Considerations

  • Maker–checker via separate edit/publish permissions; publishing requires a reason and is audited.
  • Database constraints make impossible states unrepresentable (two active versions, two drafts).
  • Prices are captured into the Razorpay order server-side; the app never sends an amount.
  • The public pricing endpoint returns only display data, never internal ids other than the version id.

Module 6 · Referral Configuration

Phase 2 · Configuration · Depends on: M0, M1, M2, M5 · Owns tables: referral_settings · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Overview

Configures the three referral programs — learner referrals (parents/students invite others), teacher-refers-teacher and institute referrals: on/off, reward amounts for the referrer and the new user, reward type, the event that qualifies a referral, caps, hold period and anti-fraud rules. Settings are versioned like payment configurations so every referral records the exact rules it earned under.

2. Business Purpose

Referrals are a cheap growth channel but easy to abuse. Admins need to tune rewards and rules as they learn, pause a program instantly, and keep an honest record of which rules applied to which reward.

3. User Stories

  • As Finance Admin, I want to set ₹100 for the inviter and ₹100 off for the new parent, paid only after the first payment, so that we only reward real customers.
  • As Super Admin, I want to pause the teacher referral program if we see abuse so that no new rewards accrue.
  • As Finance Admin, I want a 7-day hold before rewards are paid so that refunds and fraud can be caught.
  • As Support Admin, I want to see which rule version a referral used so that I can answer "why did I get ₹50 not ₹100?".

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-6.1 Programs. LEARNER_REFERRAL (qualifying event default first_payment), TEACHER_REFERRAL (teacher_approved), INSTITUTE_REFERRAL (institute_approved). Each has one active version and at most one draft.

FR-6.2 Edit & publish. Same pattern as Module 5 but always effective immediately: PUT /referral-settings/:program/draft, POST /referral-settings/:program/draft/publish { reason } (supersedes the active version). Quick toggle: POST /referral-settings/:program/toggle { enabled, reason }.

FR-6.3 Rules applied by Module 42.

  1. A referral is created when a new user signs up with a code; it stores the active referral_setting_id.
  2. When the qualifying event happens (and, for first_payment, the payment ≥ min_payment_paise), status becomes qualified, reward_release_at = now() + reward_hold_days.
  3. Caps: if the referrer already has max_rewards_per_referrer rewarded referrals, or max_rewards_per_month this calendar month, the referral is rejected with reason cap_reached.
  4. Fraud rules: block_same_device and block_same_payment_method put the referral on_hold for manual review.
  5. code_expiry_days: the referee must sign up within N days of first opening the invite link (tracked by the app).
  6. When a program is disabled, codes still open the app but no new referral rows are rewarded (created with status rejected, reason program_disabled); already-qualified referrals continue to release.
  7. Rule changes never affect referrals already created — they keep their referral_setting_id.

FR-6.4 Terms text. Markdown shown on the app's referral screen; the app shows the active version's text.

FR-6.5 Public endpoint. GET /api/v1/app/referral-programs returns enabled flag, rewards and terms per program (cached 60 s).

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
referrerRewardPaise / refereeRewardPaise 0 … 1,00,000 paise (₹1,000) each; at least one > 0 when enabled
rewardType wallet_credit, discount, cashback (discount only valid for referee reward)
qualifyingEvent allowed per program (learner: signup/first_payment; teacher: teacher_approved; institute: institute_approved)
minPaymentPaise 0 … 10,00,000; only with first_payment
maxRewardsPerReferrer null or 1–1,000
maxRewardsPerMonth null or 1–100; ≤ maxRewardsPerReferrer when both set
rewardHoldDays 0–90; must be ≥ 7 when qualifying event is first_payment (covers refund window)
codeExpiryDays null or 1–90
termsText ≤ 3,000 chars
reason 5–500 chars

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /referral-settings referral_settings.read Active and draft version per program
GET /referral-settings/:program referral_settings.read All versions of a program
PUT /referral-settings/:program/draft referral_settings.update Create/update draft
DELETE /referral-settings/:program/draft referral_settings.update Discard draft
POST /referral-settings/:program/draft/publish referral_settings.update Publish draft (immediate)
POST /referral-settings/:program/toggle referral_settings.update Enable/disable immediately
GET /api/v1/app/referral-programs (mobile) public Active program rules

  "maxRewardsPerReferrer": null, "maxRewardsPerMonth": 20, "rewardHoldDays": 7, "codeExpiryDays": 30, "blockSameDevice": true, "blockSamePaymentMethod": true,

9. PostgreSQL Tables

referral_settings

Versioned rules for each referral program. One active version per program.

CREATE TABLE referral_settings (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key (one per version)
  program_code text NOT NULL CHECK (program_code IN ('LEARNER_REFERRAL','TEACHER_REFERRAL','INSTITUTE_REFERRAL')), -- Which program
  version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0), -- Version number per program
  is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Program on/off; when off, codes still resolve but earn nothing
  referrer_reward_paise bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (referrer_reward_paise >= 0), -- Credited to the person who invited
  referee_reward_paise bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (referee_reward_paise >= 0), -- Discount or credit for the new user
  reward_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wallet_credit' CHECK (reward_type IN ('wallet_credit','discount','cashback')), -- How rewards are delivered
  qualifying_event text NOT NULL CHECK (qualifying_event IN ('signup','first_payment','teacher_approved','institute_approved')), -- Event that makes a referral count
  min_payment_paise bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (min_payment_paise >= 0), -- Minimum first payment for payment-based programs
  max_rewards_per_referrer integer CHECK (max_rewards_per_referrer IS NULL OR max_rewards_per_referrer > 0), -- Lifetime cap per referrer (NULL = no cap)
  max_rewards_per_month integer CHECK (max_rewards_per_month IS NULL OR max_rewards_per_month > 0), -- Monthly cap per referrer
  reward_hold_days integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 7 CHECK (reward_hold_days BETWEEN 0 AND 90), -- Days a reward stays pending for fraud checks / refunds
  code_expiry_days integer CHECK (code_expiry_days IS NULL OR code_expiry_days > 0), -- Days a referee has to sign up after first opening the link
  block_same_device boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Reject if referrer and referee share a device fingerprint
  block_same_payment_method boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Reject if they share a payment instrument
  terms_text text, -- Terms shown on the referral screen
  effective_from timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- When this version applies
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','active','superseded')), -- Version lifecycle
  change_reason text, -- Why it changed
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Creator
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Last updated
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_referral_settings_version ON referral_settings (program_code, version);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_referral_settings_one_active ON referral_settings (program_code) WHERE status = 'active';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_referral_settings_one_draft ON referral_settings (program_code) WHERE status = 'draft';
CREATE TRIGGER trg_referral_settings_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON referral_settings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 7 · Country Management

Phase 3 · Locations · Depends on: M0, M1, M2 · Owns tables: countries · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Maintains the list of countries GuruConnect can operate in. India is seeded and active; other countries can be prepared and kept inactive until launch. Countries are the root of the location hierarchy (country → state → city → area).

2. Business Purpose

Every address, phone prefix and currency in the platform hangs off a country. Keeping it as managed data (not hard-coded) lets GuruConnect expand to new markets such as the UAE or Nepal without code changes.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add a country and keep it inactive so that I can set up states and cities before launch.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to deactivate a country so that it disappears from app dropdowns without deleting its data.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of countries so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a country that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-7.1 List. GET /countries returns countries with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-7.2 Create. POST /countries validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-7.3 Update. PATCH /countries/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-7.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /countries/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive countries stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-7.5 Delete. DELETE /countries/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (states). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-7.6 Restore. POST /countries/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-7.S1 Deactivating a country cascades visibility: its states, cities and areas are hidden from the app (not modified) because public queries join through active parents.

FR-7.S2 The country list endpoint for dropdowns (?active=true&fields=id,name,iso2,phoneCode) is cached in Redis for 10 minutes and purged on any change in this module.

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
name Country name 2–60 chars, unique (case-insensitive)
iso2 ISO alpha-2 exactly 2 upper-case letters, unique
iso3 ISO alpha-3 exactly 3 upper-case letters
phoneCode Dialling code ^\+\d{1,4}$
currencyCode Currency ISO 4217, 3 upper-case letters
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /countries locations.read List with filters, search, sort, pagination
GET /countries/:id locations.read One country with usage counts
POST /countries locations.manage Create
PATCH /countries/:id locations.manage Update (If-Match)
POST /countries/:id/activate locations.manage Activate
POST /countries/:id/deactivate locations.manage Deactivate
DELETE /countries/:id locations.manage Soft delete (blocked when in use)
POST /countries/:id/restore locations.manage + super admin Restore a deleted country

// POST /countries
{ "name": "United Arab Emirates", "iso2": "AE", "iso3": "ARE", "phoneCode": "+971", "currencyCode": "AED", "isActive": false, "sortOrder": 2 }

// PATCH /countries/:id   (If-Match: 2026-09-20T08:11:02.114Z)
{ "isActive": true, "sortOrder": 5 }

// GET /countries?q=…&active=true&page=1&pageSize=20&sort=name:asc

// 200 GET /countries
{ "data": [ { "id": "…", "name": "India", "iso2": "IN", "iso3": "IND", "phoneCode": "+91", "currencyCode": "INR", "isActive": true, "sortOrder": 1, "stateCount": 13, "updatedAt": "…" } ], "meta": { "page": 1, "pageSize": 20, "total": 1, "totalPages": 1 } }

// 409 DELETE /countries/:id
{ "error": { "code": "CONFLICT_IN_USE", "message": "This country is used by live records. Deactivate it instead.", "details": { "references": { "states": 214 } } } }

9. PostgreSQL Tables

countries

Countries the platform can operate in. India is seeded; others stay inactive until launch.

CREATE TABLE countries (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  name text NOT NULL, -- Country name, e.g. India
  iso2 char(2) NOT NULL, -- ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. IN
  iso3 char(3) NOT NULL, -- ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, e.g. IND
  phone_code text NOT NULL, -- Dialling code with plus, e.g. +91
  currency_code char(3) NOT NULL, -- ISO 4217, e.g. INR
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Inactive countries are hidden in the app
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Manual ordering in dropdowns
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Creator
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id) -- Who deleted
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_countries_iso2 ON countries (iso2) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_countries_name ON countries (lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_countries_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON countries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

12. Indexing Strategy

Index Table Kind Definition
uq_countries_iso2 countries unique (iso2) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
uq_countries_name countries unique (lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  • Partial unique indexes enforce uniqueness among live rows only, so a deleted country name can be reused.

Module 8 · State Management

Phase 3 · Locations · Depends on: M7 · Owns tables: states · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Maintains states and union territories under each country. States are used in parent and teacher addresses, state-board mapping (Module 13) and regional reports.

2. Business Purpose

State is a required part of Indian addresses and decides which state education board applies. Clean state data keeps filters and reports consistent.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add Kerala under India with code KL so that teachers there can register.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to see how many cities each state has so that I know where coverage is thin.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of states so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a state that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-8.1 List. GET /states returns states with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-8.2 Create. POST /states validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-8.3 Update. PATCH /states/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-8.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /states/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive states stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-8.5 Delete. DELETE /states/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (cities, boards (state boards), parents). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-8.6 Restore. POST /states/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-8.S1 Moving a state to another country is not allowed once it has cities (409); create a new state instead.

FR-8.S2 Bulk import: POST /states/import accepts a CSV (country_iso2,name,code,type) up to 500 rows; the import is validated as a whole and applied in one transaction; the response lists created/skipped rows.

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
countryId Country UUID of an active country
name State name 2–60 chars, unique within the country
code Code 1–5 upper-case letters/digits, unique within the country
type Type state or union_territory
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • The parent record (countries) must exist, be active and not deleted.
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

9. PostgreSQL Tables

states

States and union territories within a country.

CREATE TABLE states (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  country_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES countries(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Parent country
  name text NOT NULL, -- State name, e.g. Karnataka
  code text NOT NULL, -- Short code, e.g. KA (ISO 3166-2 suffix)
  type text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'state' CHECK (type IN ('state','union_territory')), -- Administrative type
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Hidden in the app when false
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Manual ordering
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Creator
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id) -- Who deleted
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_states_country_name ON states (country_id, lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_states_country_code ON states (country_id, code) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_states_country_active ON states (country_id, is_active) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_states_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON states FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 9 · City Management

Phase 3 · Locations · Depends on: M8 · Owns tables: cities · Build estimate: 1–2 days

1. Module Overview

Maintains cities under states, including map coordinates, market tier and whether the city is a live ("serviceable") launch city. Cities drive search, featured slots per city, city-wise analytics and banner targeting.

2. Business Purpose

GuruConnect launches city by city. Admins need to add a city, prepare its areas and teachers, and flip it to serviceable on launch day without an app release.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add Kochi as a tier-2 city and keep it non-serviceable until we have 50 verified teachers.
  • As Super Admin, I want to mark Kochi serviceable on launch day so that it appears in the city picker.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to see teachers and users per city so that I can prioritise launches.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of cities so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a city that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-9.1 List. GET /cities returns cities with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-9.2 Create. POST /cities validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-9.3 Update. PATCH /cities/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-9.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /cities/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive cities stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-9.5 Delete. DELETE /cities/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (areas, teacher_locations, institutes, parents, students). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-9.6 Restore. POST /cities/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-9.S1 Marking a city serviceable requires a confirmation showing current counts (verified teachers, institutes, areas). A warning appears when there are fewer than 20 verified teachers, but it is not blocking.

FR-9.S2 Changing a slug is allowed only while the city is not serviceable (deep links and SEO pages use it).

FR-9.S3 City stats (GET /cities/:id/stats) return verified teachers, institutes, parents, students and areas — read from daily_platform_stats.city_breakdown when Module 47 exists, else live counts.

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
stateId State UUID of an active state
name City name 2–60 chars, unique within the state
slug Slug auto from name, ^[a-z0-9-]{2,60}$, globally unique
latitude Latitude −90…90, 6 decimals
longitude Longitude −180…180, 6 decimals
tier Tier 1, 2 or 3
isServiceable Serviceable boolean
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • The parent record (states) must exist, be active and not deleted.
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

6. API Endpoints

GET /cities/:id locations.read One city with usage counts

POST /cities/:id/activate locations.manage Activate
POST /cities/:id/deactivate locations.manage Deactivate
DELETE /cities/:id locations.manage Soft delete (blocked when in use)
POST /cities/:id/restore locations.manage + super admin Restore a deleted city
GET /cities/:id/stats locations.manage Counts of teachers, institutes, users, areas

cities

Cities where teachers and institutes can be listed.

CREATE TABLE cities (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  state_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES states(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Parent state
  name text NOT NULL, -- City name, e.g. Bengaluru

  longitude numeric(9,6) CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180), -- City centre longitude
  tier smallint CHECK (tier IN (1,2,3)), -- Market tier, used for pricing and featured slots
  is_serviceable boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- true = shown as a launch city in search
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Hidden everywhere when false
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Manual ordering

  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id) -- Who deleted
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cities_state_name ON cities (state_id, lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cities_slug ON cities (slug) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_cities_state_active ON cities (state_id, is_active) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_cities_name_trgm ON cities USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_cities_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON cities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 10 · Area Management

Phase 3 · Locations · Depends on: M9 · Owns tables: areas · Build estimate: 1–2 days

1. Module Overview

Maintains localities within each city (e.g. Koramangala, HSR Layout) with PIN codes and coordinates. Areas power "nearby teachers", teacher coverage (Module 20) and parent addresses.

2. Business Purpose

Parents choose tutors by neighbourhood. Accurate areas with PIN codes make home-tuition matching and distance sorting work.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to bulk-import 120 areas of Pune from a spreadsheet so that the city is ready quickly.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to merge two duplicate areas so that teachers and parents point to one record.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of areas so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a area that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-10.1 List. GET /areas returns areas with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-10.2 Create. POST /areas validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-10.3 Update. PATCH /areas/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-10.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /areas/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive areas stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-10.5 Delete. DELETE /areas/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (teacher_locations, institutes, parents, students). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-10.6 Restore. POST /areas/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-10.S1 Bulk import. POST /areas/import (CSV city_slug,name,pincodes,latitude,longitude, up to 2,000 rows). Validate all rows first; response returns row-level errors; apply only when there are no errors (or with skipInvalid=true).

FR-10.S2 Merge. POST /areas/:id/merge { intoAreaId, reason } moves every reference (teacher_locations, institutes, parents, students) from the source to the target area in one transaction, unions PIN codes, then soft-deletes the source. Both areas must be in the same city.

FR-10.S3 PIN lookup. GET /areas/by-pincode/:pin returns the areas that contain a PIN (used by support and by the app to prefill addresses).

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
cityId City UUID of an active city
name Area name 2–80 chars, unique within the city
slug Slug auto from name, unique within the city
pincodes PIN codes 0–20 items, each ^[1-9][0-9]{5}$, no duplicates
latitude Latitude optional
longitude Longitude optional
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • The parent record (cities) must exist, be active and not deleted.
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

9. PostgreSQL Tables

areas

Localities within a city, used for "nearby" search and teacher coverage.

CREATE TABLE areas (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  city_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Parent city
  name text NOT NULL, -- Area name, e.g. Koramangala
  slug text NOT NULL, -- Slug unique within the city
  pincodes text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- 6-digit Indian PIN codes covered
  latitude numeric(9,6) CHECK (latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90), -- Area centre latitude
  longitude numeric(9,6) CHECK (longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180), -- Area centre longitude
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Hidden when false
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Manual ordering
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Creator
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id) -- Who deleted
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_areas_city_name ON areas (city_id, lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_areas_city_slug ON areas (city_id, slug) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_areas_city_active ON areas (city_id, is_active) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;

Module 11 · Class Management

Phase 4 · Education Masters · Depends on: M0, M1, M2 · Owns tables: classes · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Maintains the grades and levels learners study at — Class 1 to Class 12, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Competitive exam preparation and Adult learners — each with a stage and a numeric order used for range matching in recommendations.

2. Business Purpose

Class is the strongest signal for matching a child to a teacher. The numeric level_order lets the system answer "teachers for Class 4" when a teacher covers "Class 1–5".

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add "Class 11 (Droppers)" as a level so that repeat-year students can be targeted.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to reorder classes by dragging so that dropdowns show them in teaching order.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of classes so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a class that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-11.1 List. GET /classes returns classes with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-11.2 Create. POST /classes validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-11.3 Update. PATCH /classes/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-11.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /classes/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive classes stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-11.5 Delete. DELETE /classes/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (teacher_classes, parent_children, students, institute_teacher_classes, institute_batches, leads). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-11.6 Restore. POST /classes/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-11.S1 Reorder. PUT /classes/order { ids: [...] } rewrites level_order in the given sequence (1…n). Reordering warns that recommendation ranges use this order.

FR-11.S2 code is immutable because the mobile app and analytics reference it.

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
name Name 2–40 chars, unique
code Code ^[A-Z0-9_]{2,30}$, unique, immutable after creation
stage Stage one of pre_primary, primary, middle, secondary, senior_secondary, undergraduate, postgraduate, competitive, adult
levelOrder Level order integer 0–50
isActive Active boolean
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description

GET /classes/:id education_masters.read One class with usage counts
POST /classes education_masters.manage Create
PATCH /classes/:id education_masters.manage Update (If-Match)
POST /classes/:id/activate education_masters.manage Activate
POST /classes/:id/deactivate education_masters.manage Deactivate
DELETE /classes/:id education_masters.manage Soft delete (blocked when in use)
POST /classes/:id/restore education_masters.manage + super admin Restore a deleted class
PUT /classes/order education_masters.manage Reorder (rewrites level_order)

);

Module 12 · Subject Management

Phase 4 · Education Masters · Depends on: M0, M1, M2, M11 · Owns tables: subjects · Build estimate: 2 days

1. Module Overview

Maintains subjects, competitive exams, languages, arts and skills that teachers teach — with categories, optional parent subject, search aliases, an icon, the class range the subject applies to, and a "trending" flag for the app home screen.

2. Business Purpose

Subjects are the primary search term. Aliases ("maths" → Mathematics) and hierarchy (Organic Chemistry → Chemistry) make search forgiving; class ranges keep irrelevant subjects out of a Class 3 parent's choices.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add "Vedic Maths" under Mathematics with alias "speed maths" so that parents find it.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to pin five trending subjects so that the app home screen reflects exam season.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to merge "Maths" into "Mathematics" so that teachers are not split across duplicates.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of subjects so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a subject that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-12.1 List. GET /subjects returns subjects with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-12.2 Create. POST /subjects validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-12.3 Update. PATCH /subjects/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-12.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /subjects/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive subjects stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-12.5 Delete. DELETE /subjects/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (teacher_subjects, parent_child_subjects, institute_teacher_subjects, leads, child subjects). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-12.6 Restore. POST /subjects/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-12.S1 Merge. POST /subjects/:id/merge { intoSubjectId, reason } moves references in teacher_subjects, parent_child_subjects, institute_teacher_subjects, leads and institute_batches.subject_ids (dropping duplicates), adds the source name to the target's aliases, and soft-deletes the source.

FR-12.S2 Trending. Setting isTrending on an 11th subject returns 409; the UI shows the current 10 to swap.

FR-12.S3 Class range use. Module 29 (children) and the app only offer subjects whose range covers the child's class (NULL bounds mean open-ended).

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
name Name 2–60 chars, unique
slug Slug auto, unique
category Category academic, competitive_exam, language, music_arts, coding_skills, other
parentSubjectId Parent subject optional UUID; max depth 2; not itself or a descendant
aliases Aliases 0–15 strings, 2–40 chars each, lower-cased, unique within the subject
iconFileId Icon optional uploaded image (purpose subject_icon)
minClassOrder / maxClassOrder Class range optional; min ≤ max; must match existing class orders
isTrending Trending boolean; at most 10 trending subjects
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

POST /subjects education_masters.manage Create

POST /subjects/:id/activate education_masters.manage Activate
POST /subjects/:id/deactivate education_masters.manage Deactivate
DELETE /subjects/:id education_masters.manage Soft delete (blocked when in use)
POST /subjects/:id/restore education_masters.manage + super admin Restore a deleted subject
POST /subjects/:id/merge education_masters.manage Merge a duplicate subject

9. PostgreSQL Tables

subjects

Subjects, exams and skills teachers can teach.

CREATE TABLE subjects (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  name text NOT NULL, -- Display name, e.g. Physics
  slug text NOT NULL, -- URL slug, e.g. physics
  category text NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('academic','competitive_exam','language','music_arts','coding_skills','other')), -- Grouping for filters
  parent_subject_id uuid REFERENCES subjects(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Optional parent, e.g. Organic Chemistry → Chemistry
  aliases text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- Search synonyms, e.g. {maths, math}
  icon_file_id uuid REFERENCES files(id), -- Optional icon shown in the app
  min_class_order smallint, -- Lowest classes.level_order this subject is offered for (NULL = any)
  max_class_order smallint, -- Highest classes.level_order (NULL = any)
  is_trending boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Pinned in Trending subjects on the app home screen
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Hidden when false
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Manual ordering
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Creator
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Who deleted
  CONSTRAINT ck_subjects_class_range CHECK (min_class_order IS NULL OR max_class_order IS NULL OR min_class_order <= max_class_order),
  CONSTRAINT ck_subjects_not_self_parent CHECK (parent_subject_id IS NULL OR parent_subject_id <> id)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_subjects_slug ON subjects (slug) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_subjects_name ON subjects (lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_subjects_category ON subjects (category, is_active) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_subjects_name_trgm ON subjects USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX idx_subjects_aliases ON subjects USING gin (aliases);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_subjects_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON subjects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

idx_subjects_name_trgm subjects gin USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops)
idx_subjects_aliases subjects gin USING gin (aliases)
  • Partial unique indexes enforce uniqueness among live rows only, so a deleted subject name can be reused.
  • The table is small; sort-order scans are cheap. Usage counts come from indexed foreign keys on the referencing tables.
  • Trigram indexes on name (where present) back fuzzy search.

Module 13 · Board Management

Phase 4 · Education Masters · Depends on: M8, M11 · Owns tables: boards · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Maintains education boards and curricula — CBSE, ICSE/ISC, IB, IGCSE, NIOS and state boards — used on children, students, teacher class mappings and filters.

2. Business Purpose

Parents want tutors who know their child's syllabus. Boards let teachers declare expertise and parents filter by it.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add the Kerala State Board linked to Kerala so that parents there can pick it.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to deactivate a board that no longer exists so that new users cannot pick it but old records keep it.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of boards so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a board that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-13.1 List. GET /boards returns boards with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-13.2 Create. POST /boards validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-13.3 Update. PATCH /boards/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-13.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /boards/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive boards stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-13.5 Delete. DELETE /boards/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (teacher_classes, parent_children, students). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-13.6 Restore. POST /boards/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-13.S1 The app shows national and international boards everywhere, and state boards only to users in that state (plus an "Other state board" option).

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
name Full name 3–120 chars
shortName Short name 2–40 chars, unique (case-insensitive)
type Type national, state, international, university, other
stateId State required when type = state, must be empty otherwise
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • The parent record (states (state boards only)) must exist, be active and not deleted.
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /boards education_masters.read List with filters, search, sort, pagination
GET /boards/:id education_masters.read One board with usage counts
POST /boards education_masters.manage Create
PATCH /boards/:id education_masters.manage Update (If-Match)
POST /boards/:id/activate education_masters.manage Activate
POST /boards/:id/deactivate education_masters.manage Deactivate
DELETE /boards/:id education_masters.manage Soft delete (blocked when in use)
POST /boards/:id/restore education_masters.manage + super admin Restore a deleted board

// 409 DELETE /boards/:id

9. PostgreSQL Tables

boards

Education boards and curricula, e.g. CBSE, ICSE, state boards, IB.

CREATE TABLE boards (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  name text NOT NULL, -- Full name, e.g. Central Board of Secondary Education
  short_name text NOT NULL, -- Short name shown in chips, e.g. CBSE
  type text NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('national','state','international','university','other')), -- Board type
  state_id uuid REFERENCES states(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Required for state boards, NULL otherwise
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Hidden when false
  sort_order integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Manual ordering
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Creator
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Who deleted
  CONSTRAINT ck_boards_state CHECK ((type = 'state') = (state_id IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_boards_short_name ON boards (lower(short_name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_boards_type ON boards (type, is_active) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_boards_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON boards FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 14 · Teaching Mode Management

Phase 4 · Education Masters · Depends on: M0, M1, M2 · Owns tables: teaching_modes · Build estimate: 0.5–1 day

1. Module Overview

Maintains how classes are delivered: Online, At teacher's place, Home tuition, Hybrid and Group batch. Each mode says whether a location is needed.

2. Business Purpose

Mode is a top filter for parents ("home tutor near me" vs "online"). The requires_location flag tells the app when to ask for city/area.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to rename "Offline" to "At teacher's place" so that parents understand it.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to add "Recorded course" later without an app update.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of teaching modes so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a teaching mode that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-14.1 List. GET /teaching-modes returns teaching modes with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-14.2 Create. POST /teaching-modes validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-14.3 Update. PATCH /teaching-modes/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-14.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /teaching-modes/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive teaching modes stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-14.5 Delete. DELETE /teaching-modes/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (teacher_teaching_modes, parent_children.preferred_mode_id, institute_batches, demo_requests). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-14.6 Restore. POST /teaching-modes/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-14.S1 The five seeded codes (ONLINE, OFFLINE, HOME_TUITION, HYBRID, BATCH) are referenced by app logic and cannot be deleted or deactivated (409); only name, description and order can change.

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
name Name 2–40 chars, unique
code Code ^[A-Z_]{3,30}$, unique, immutable
description Description ≤ 200 chars
requiresLocation Needs location boolean
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

Module 15 · Teacher Category Management

Phase 4 · Education Masters · Depends on: M0, M1, M2 · Owns tables: teacher_categories · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Maintains teacher types — Home Tutor, School Teacher, Coaching Faculty, Competitive Exam Faculty, Language Trainer, Music & Arts Teacher, Coding & Skills Mentor — shown as the category grid in the app and used for parent preferences per child.

2. Business Purpose

Categories are how parents think ("I need a home tutor for Riya"). They drive home-screen navigation, filters and the per-child recommendation engine.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add a "Sports Coach" category with an icon so that it appears on the app home grid.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to reorder categories so that the most searched appear first.
  • As any admin with read access, I want a searchable, filterable list of teacher categories so that I can find one in seconds.
  • As Operations Admin, I want deleting a teacher category that is in use to be blocked with a clear message so that live records are never orphaned.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-15.1 List. GET /teacher-categories returns teacher categories with usage counts, filters, search and sorting. ?active=true&fields=id,name returns a lightweight list for dropdowns (cached in Redis 10 min, purged on any write in this module). FR-15.2 Create. POST /teacher-categories validates, generates the slug/code where applicable, inserts, audits and purges caches. FR-15.3 Update. PATCH /teacher-categories/:id with If-Match. Changing identifying fields (code, slug) follows the rules below. FR-15.4 Activate / deactivate. POST /teacher-categories/:id/activate and /deactivate (reason optional). Inactive teacher categories stay on existing records but are hidden from app choices and new admin forms. FR-15.5 Delete. DELETE /teacher-categories/:id soft-deletes only when no live row references it (teachers.category_id, parent_child_teacher_categories). Otherwise 409 CONFLICT_IN_USE with counts per referencing table, and the UI offers "Deactivate instead". FR-15.6 Restore. POST /teacher-categories/:id/restore (super admin) undeletes if the unique fields are still free. FR-15.S1 Reorder. PUT /teacher-categories/order { ids } (drag and drop).

FR-15.S2 Deactivating a category that teachers use keeps it on their profiles but removes it from filters and onboarding choices; the UI shows the number of affected teachers first.

5. Validation Rules

Field Label Rule
name Name 2–50 chars, unique
slug Slug auto, unique
description Description ≤ 200 chars
iconFileId Icon optional image (purpose category_icon, 128×128 PNG/SVG-rasterised)
isActive Active boolean
sortOrder Order 0–9,999; the first 8 active categories show on the home grid
  • Unique checks ignore soft-deleted rows (partial unique indexes); the API maps PostgreSQL error 23505 to CONFLICT_DUPLICATE with the conflicting field.
  • All strings trimmed; names collapse inner whitespace; slugs lower-case with hyphens.

12. Indexing Strategy

Index Table Kind Definition
uq_teacher_categories_slug teacher_categories unique (slug) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
uq_teacher_categories_name teacher_categories unique (lower(name)) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  • Partial unique indexes enforce uniqueness among live rows only, so a deleted teacher category name can be reused.
  • The table is small; sort-order scans are cheap. Usage counts come from indexed foreign keys on the referencing tables.
  • Trigram indexes on name (where present) back fuzzy search.

Module 16 · Teacher Registration Queue

Phase 5 · Teachers · Depends on: M0–M2, M5 (fee on/off), M15 · Owns tables: teachers, teacher_documents, teacher_verification_logs · Reads: files, app_users, teacher_categories · Build estimate: 6–7 days

1. Module Overview

The verification workspace for new teachers. Teachers register in the app, upload Aadhaar, PAN, educational and professional certificates, pay the registration fee (if enabled) and land in this queue. Verification Admins review each document individually (approve, reject, request re-upload), add notes, see automated checks, and finally approve or reject the application. Approved teachers become visible in search.

2. Business Purpose

Trust is GuruConnect's core promise: "every teacher is verified before they appear". This queue is where that promise is kept. It must be fast (target decision within 24 hours), consistent (checklists, reason codes) and fully traceable (every decision logged with who and why).

3. User Stories

  • As a Verification Admin, I want a queue sorted by oldest submission with an SLA timer so that nobody waits more than 24 hours.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to open a document in a secure viewer, compare the name with the application and approve it so that I can verify quickly.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to request a re-upload with a reason the teacher sees so that they can fix a blurry certificate without re-registering.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to see automated checks (name match, duplicate Aadhaar, face match) so that I can focus on risky cases.
  • As Super Admin, I want only admins with the decide permission to approve or reject a teacher so that final decisions stay with trusted staff.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to claim a case so that two reviewers don't work on the same teacher.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

Status machine (teachers.verification_status)

draft ──teacher submits──▶ pending ──admin opens/claims──▶ under_review
under_review ──request re-upload──▶ reupload_requested ──teacher re-uploads──▶ pending
under_review ──approve (all required docs approved)──▶ approved
under_review ──reject──▶ rejected ──(teacher may re-apply after 30 days)──▶ draft
approved ──(Module 17) suspend/activate changes account_status only

Required documents for approval: current aadhaar approved, current pan approved, ≥ 1 education_certificate approved, profile photo present. professional_certificate and experience_letter are optional but, if uploaded, must not be in submitted state at approval time.

FR-16.1 Queue. GET /teacher-verifications lists teachers in pending, under_review, reupload_requested (default tab: pending + under_review), oldest submitted_at first. Each row: name, public code, primary subject, city, submitted age (hours), SLA state (green < 12 h, amber 12–24 h, red > 24 h), assigned reviewer, document summary (e.g., "3/4 approved"), automated-check warnings, payment status (paid / not required / refunded).

FR-16.2 Claim. Opening a case with POST /teacher-verifications/:teacherId/claim sets reviewed_by to the admin and status pending → under_review. A case claimed by someone else shows "Being reviewed by Anjali (12 min)". Claims expire after 30 minutes of inactivity (a job clears reviewed_by on untouched cases). ?force=true lets a user with teacher_verification.decide take over (logged).

FR-16.3 Case detail. GET /teacher-verifications/:teacherId returns application data, all current and previous document versions (masked numbers, thumbnails as 60-s signed URLs), automated checks, notes, verification timeline, payment reference, and possible duplicates.

FR-16.4 Automated checks (run by a job when documents are submitted; results in teacher_verification_logs with action = 'auto_check', metadata):

Check Rule Result
Name match Fuzzy match (token-set ratio) between application name and names extracted by OCR from Aadhaar and PAN ≥ 0.85 pass, 0.6–0.85 warn, < 0.6 fail
Duplicate identity Same doc_number_hash on another teacher's current Aadhaar/PAN fail + link to the other teacher
Face match Selfie/profile photo vs Aadhaar photo similarity (vendor API) ≥ 0.9 pass, 0.75–0.9 warn
Age DOB on Aadhaar ≥ 18 years fail if under 18
Image quality Resolution ≥ 800 px short side, not blank warn
Automated checks never approve or reject on their own; they only inform the reviewer. The integrations sit behind an IdentityChecks interface so vendors can change.

FR-16.5 Document decisions. POST /teacher-documents/:documentId/approve, /reject { reasonCode, note }, /request-reupload { reasonCode, note }. Only current versions can be decided. Rejecting or requesting re-upload of any document with the teacher in under_review does not change teacher status by itself; the reviewer then uses "Send back for re-upload" (FR-16.7) to notify the teacher once, with all requested items.

FR-16.6 Notes. POST /teacher-verifications/:teacherId/notes { note, isInternal }. Non-internal notes are shown to the teacher in the app.

FR-16.7 Send back for re-upload. POST /teacher-verifications/:teacherId/request-reupload { message } — requires at least one document in reupload_requested/rejected; sets status reupload_requested, clears reviewed_by, sends push + SMS listing the documents and reasons. When the teacher re-uploads, a new document version is created (version + 1, previous is_current = false) and the teacher returns to pending (keeping the original submitted_at for SLA fairness; resubmitted logged).

FR-16.8 Approve. POST /teacher-verifications/:teacherId/approve { grantBadge: true, note } (permission teacher_verification.decide):

  1. Assert required documents rule; assert no failed duplicate-identity check (or overrideDuplicate: true with reason, super admin only).
  2. In one transaction: status approved, approved_at, optionally is_verified_badge = true with badge_granted_*; log approved and badge_granted; audit.
  3. After commit: enqueue trust score calculation (Module 36), mark teacher searchable (search index refresh), push "You're verified" notification, activate the teacher subscription period if the registration fee was paid (Module 41) — the 12-month validity starts at approval, not payment.
  4. If the teacher was referred, emit teacher.approved for Module 42.

FR-16.9 Reject. POST /teacher-verifications/:teacherId/reject { reasonCode, note } (teacher_verification.decide): status rejected, rejected_at, reason stored; push + SMS with the reason; if a registration fee was captured and the fee version says refundable, create a refund request (Module 40, reason teacher_rejected, auto-approved). Reason codes: DOC_UNREADABLE, NAME_MISMATCH, QUALIFICATION_UNVERIFIED, FORGED_DOCUMENT, DUPLICATE_ACCOUNT, UNDERAGE, OTHER. FORGED_DOCUMENT also suspends the app_users account and blocks the document hash.

FR-16.10 Manual creation. POST /teachers (teachers.create) lets an admin create a teacher for someone who can't use the app: creates app_users (phone), teachers (created_by), uploads documents via Module 0 files, and can submit directly into the queue. A different admin must approve it (maker–checker: the creator cannot approve the same teacher).

FR-16.11 SLA alerts. A job every 15 minutes emails admins with queue_alerts on when any case passes 24 hours, and the dashboard (Module 47) shows the queue size and oldest age.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
reasonCode required for reject / request-reupload; from the list in FR-16.9 (documents also allow BLURRY, CROPPED, EXPIRED, WRONG_DOCUMENT)
note reject/re-upload: 10–500 chars (shown to the teacher; no internal jargon); internal notes 1–2,000 chars
message (send back) 10–500 chars
grantBadge boolean, default true
overrideDuplicate boolean; requires super admin and reason 10–500 chars
Manual create fullName 2–100, phone E.164 unique among live app users, email optional unique, gender enum, dateOfBirth ≥ 18 years ago and ≤ 90, categoryId active, experienceYears 0–60, highestQualification 2–120
Decision preconditions teacher must be under_review and claimed by the caller (or force) for document decisions, approve and reject

9. PostgreSQL Tables

teachers

Teacher profile and verification state. One row per teacher app account.

CREATE TABLE teachers (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Login identity
  public_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT ('GC-T' || nextval('seq_teacher_code')), -- Human-friendly id shown in the portal, e.g. GC-T10241
  full_name text NOT NULL, -- Name as on Aadhaar
  gender text CHECK (gender IN ('female','male','other','undisclosed')), -- Gender
  date_of_birth date, -- Must make the teacher at least 18
  email citext, -- Contact email
  phone text NOT NULL, -- E.164 mobile number
  profile_photo_file_id uuid REFERENCES files(id), -- Public profile photo
  category_id uuid REFERENCES teacher_categories(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Primary teacher category
  highest_qualification text, -- e.g. M.Sc. Physics
  experience_years smallint CHECK (experience_years BETWEEN 0 AND 60), -- Years of teaching experience
  bio text, -- About the teacher, max 2,000 chars
  languages text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- Languages spoken, e.g. {English, Hindi}
  fee_per_hour_paise bigint CHECK (fee_per_hour_paise IS NULL OR fee_per_hour_paise >= 0), -- Indicative hourly fee
  demo_available boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Offers a free demo class
  verification_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (verification_status IN ('draft','pending','under_review','reupload_requested','approved','rejected')), -- Registration workflow state
  account_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (account_status IN ('active','suspended')), -- Suspended teachers are hidden from search and cannot receive leads
  is_verified_badge boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Blue Verified badge on the profile
  badge_granted_at timestamptz, -- When the badge was granted
  badge_granted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Who granted it
  is_featured boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Featured rail placement
  featured_until timestamptz, -- Paid or manual featured expiry
  is_premium boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Premium listing (search boost)
  premium_until timestamptz, -- Premium expiry
  registration_transaction_id uuid, -- Registration fee payment (FK added in migration 040)
  submitted_at timestamptz, -- When the teacher submitted for review
  reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Admin currently assigned / last reviewer
  approved_at timestamptz, -- Approval time
  rejected_at timestamptz, -- Rejection time
  rejection_reason_code text, -- e.g. DOC_UNREADABLE, NAME_MISMATCH, FORGED_DOCUMENT
  rejection_note text, -- Explanation sent to the teacher
  suspended_at timestamptz, -- Suspension time
  suspension_reason text, -- Internal reason for suspension
  profile_completeness smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (profile_completeness BETWEEN 0 AND 100), -- Percentage, recalculated on profile change
  trust_score numeric(5,2), -- Cached from trust_scores for fast sorting
  rating_avg numeric(3,2), -- Cached average of published reviews
  rating_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Cached count of published reviews
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Set when an admin created the teacher manually
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last admin editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id) -- Who deleted
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teachers_user ON teachers (user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teachers_public_code ON teachers (public_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_teachers_queue ON teachers (verification_status, submitted_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_teachers_listing ON teachers (account_status, verification_status, trust_score DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_teachers_category ON teachers (category_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_teachers_name_trgm ON teachers USING gin (full_name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE INDEX idx_teachers_featured ON teachers (featured_until) WHERE is_featured AND deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_teachers_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON teachers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE teachers ADD CONSTRAINT fk_teachers_registration_txn FOREIGN KEY (registration_transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

teacher_documents

Every uploaded verification document version. Only one current version per teacher and type.

CREATE TABLE teacher_documents (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Owner
  doc_type text NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('aadhaar','pan','education_certificate','professional_certificate','experience_letter','photo')), -- Document type
  file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Private stored file
  title text, -- e.g. B.Ed., Bangalore University 2010 (for certificates)
  doc_number_masked text, -- Masked number shown in the UI, e.g. XXXX XXXX 2978
  doc_number_hash text, -- HMAC-SHA256 of the normalised number, used to detect duplicate accounts
  version smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- Upload count for this type
  is_current boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- false once a newer upload replaces it
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted' CHECK (status IN ('submitted','approved','rejected','reupload_requested')), -- Review state
  review_note text, -- Reason shown to the teacher on reject / re-upload
  reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Reviewer
  reviewed_at timestamptz, -- Review time
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Uploaded
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Last updated
);
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_documents_teacher ON teacher_documents (teacher_id, doc_type) WHERE is_current;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teacher_documents_current_identity ON teacher_documents (teacher_id, doc_type) WHERE is_current AND doc_type IN ('aadhaar','pan','photo');
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_documents_hash ON teacher_documents (doc_type, doc_number_hash) WHERE doc_number_hash IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_documents_pending ON teacher_documents (status, created_at) WHERE is_current AND status = 'submitted';
CREATE TRIGGER trg_teacher_documents_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

teacher_verification_logs

Timeline of every verification event for a teacher, shown in the review screen.

CREATE TABLE teacher_verification_logs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Teacher
  document_id uuid REFERENCES teacher_documents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Document the event relates to, if any
  action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('submitted','resubmitted','assigned','document_approved','document_rejected','reupload_requested','note_added','approved','rejected','badge_granted','badge_revoked','suspended','activated','auto_check')), -- Event type
  from_status text, -- Teacher verification_status before
  to_status text, -- Teacher verification_status after
  note text, -- Internal note or reason
  is_internal boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- false = note is also shown to the teacher
  metadata jsonb, -- Extra data, e.g. automated check results {"face_match":0.96}
  admin_id uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- NULL for teacher or system events
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- When
);
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_verification_logs_teacher ON teacher_verification_logs (teacher_id, created_at DESC);

Migration file: sql/migrations/016_m16_teacher_registration_queue.sql

12. Indexing Strategy

Index Table Kind Definition
uq_teachers_user teachers unique (user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
uq_teachers_public_code teachers unique (public_code)
idx_teachers_queue teachers btree (verification_status, submitted_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
idx_teachers_listing teachers btree (account_status, verification_status, trust_score DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
idx_teachers_category teachers btree (category_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
idx_teachers_name_trgm teachers gin USING gin (full_name gin_trgm_ops)
idx_teachers_featured teachers btree (featured_until) WHERE is_featured AND deleted_at IS NULL
idx_teacher_documents_teacher teacher_documents btree (teacher_id, doc_type) WHERE is_current
uq_teacher_documents_current_identity teacher_documents unique (teacher_id, doc_type) WHERE is_current AND doc_type IN ('aadhaar','pan','photo')
idx_teacher_documents_hash teacher_documents btree (doc_type, doc_number_hash) WHERE doc_number_hash IS NOT NULL
idx_teacher_documents_pending teacher_documents btree (status, created_at) WHERE is_current AND status = 'submitted'
idx_teacher_verification_logs_teacher teacher_verification_logs btree (teacher_id, created_at DESC)
  • idx_teachers_queue (verification_status, submitted_at) serves the queue ordered by age.
  • idx_teacher_documents_hash finds duplicate identities across teachers in O(log n).
  • idx_teacher_documents_pending serves "documents awaiting review" counts.
  • uq_teacher_documents_current_identity guarantees one current Aadhaar, PAN and photo per teacher.

21. Future Scalability Notes & Enhancements

  • DigiLocker / UIDAI offline e-KYC and NSDL PAN verification APIs to replace manual checks for identity documents.
  • University registry integrations (NAD / DigiLocker academic records) for certificates.
  • Round-robin auto-assignment and reviewer workload balancing.
  • Two-reviewer rule for high-risk cases (failed checks).
  • Queue partitioning by city/language when reviewers specialise.

22. Security Considerations

  • Originals are only accessible through audited, 60-second signed URLs with a watermarked viewer; downloads disabled in the UI.
  • Aadhaar numbers are never stored in full: only masked last 4 and an HMAC (key in KMS) for duplicate detection.
  • Maker–checker for manually created teachers; decide permission separated from review.
  • Forged-document rejections block the identity hash from future sign-ups.

Module 17 · Teacher Profile Management

Phase 5 · Teachers · Depends on: M16 · Owns tables: none · Reads: teachers, teacher_documents, teacher_verification_logs, teacher_subjects, teacher_classes, teacher_locations, trust_scores · Build estimate: 4 days

1. Module Overview

The admin view of every teacher after registration: a searchable teacher directory and a teacher detail page where admins can edit profile fields, suspend or re-activate, grant or revoke the Verified badge, and set featured/premium listing manually. The detail page aggregates the teacher's subjects, classes, locations (Modules 18–20), analytics (21), reviews (33), trust score (36), leads (38) and complaints (43) in tabs.

2. Business Purpose

Operations and support need one place to look after a teacher: fix a typo in a qualification, hide a teacher during an investigation, feature top performers, and see everything about them before taking action.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to find a teacher by name, code or phone and open their full profile so that I can answer a parent's question.
  • As Support Admin, I want to suspend a teacher with a reason so that they stop receiving leads during a complaint investigation.
  • As Verification Admin, I want to revoke the Verified badge if a certificate turns out to be fake so that parents are protected.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to feature a teacher for 30 days as a reward so that they appear on the home screen.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to export the filtered teacher list so that I can plan a city campaign.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-17.1 Directory. GET /teachers with filters (below), search, sort and export. Row: avatar, name + badge, code, category, primary subject + other subjects (chips), primary city/area, mode(s), experience, fee, rating (count), trust score, plan (free / registered / premium), verification status, account status, featured switch.

FR-17.2 Detail. GET /teachers/:id returns profile, verification summary, current trust score, subscription state, counts (leads 30d, demos, reviews, complaints open). Tabs load their data from their own modules' endpoints.

FR-17.3 Edit profile. PATCH /teachers/:id (If-Match) for: full name*, gender, date of birth*, email, category, highest qualification*, experience years, bio, languages, fee per hour, demo availability, profile photo (fileId). Fields marked * are identity-linked: changing them on an approved teacher requires a reason and sets a profile_changed_after_approval warning in the verification timeline; changing fullName or dateOfBirth also re-runs the name/age checks. Phone number changes are not allowed here (the teacher changes it in the app with OTP).

FR-17.4 Suspend / activate. POST /teachers/:id/suspend { reason, notifyTeacher, until? }: account_status = 'suspended', suspended_at, reason; teacher disappears from search within 1 minute (cache purge); open leads show "Teacher unavailable"; future demos are cancelled with cancelled_by = 'admin' and learners notified; featured/premium periods are paused (remaining days stored in metadata and restored on activation). Optional until schedules automatic re-activation. POST /teachers/:id/activate { reason } reverses it.

FR-17.5 Badge. POST /teachers/:id/badge { grant: true|false, reason } — grant only if verification_status = 'approved'. Revoking also triggers a trust score recalculation (the badge feeds the verification factors).

FR-17.6 Featured / premium (manual). POST /teachers/:id/feature { featured: true, until, reason } and /premium { premium: true, until, reason } for complimentary placements (paid ones come from Module 40 transactions). Featured slots per city are limited by the active FEATURED_TEACHER configuration (Module 5 — slots setting in system settings limits.featured_slots_per_city, default 12); exceeding it returns 409 with the current featured list.

FR-17.7 Soft delete. DELETE /teachers/:id { reason } (super admin only) for spam or at the teacher's request: soft-deletes the teacher, hides reviews from public, anonymises contact fields after 30 days (job), keeps transactions and complaints.

FR-17.8 Profile completeness. Recomputed on every change: photo 15, bio ≥ 100 chars 10, qualification 10, experience 5, ≥ 1 subject 15, ≥ 1 class 10, ≥ 1 location or online mode 10, fee 5, languages 5, ≥ 1 certificate approved 15 (= 100). Stored in profile_completeness; feeds the trust score.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
fullName 2–100 chars; reason required if approved
dateOfBirth teacher ≥ 18 and ≤ 90 years
email valid, unique among live app users
categoryId active teacher category
highestQualification 2–120 chars
experienceYears 0–60, ≤ age − 16
bio ≤ 2,000 chars, no phone numbers/emails/URLs (regex check — contact details must go through leads)
languages 1–10 items from the supported list
feePerHourPaise 0 … 1,00,000 paise (₹1,000) × 10 = max ₹10,000/hour
suspend.reason 10–500 chars; until optional, > now, ≤ 365 days
feature/premium.until > now, ≤ 90 days

6. API Endpoints

GET /teachers/export teachers.read CSV of the current filter (sync ≤ 5,000 rows, else async via M48)
GET /teachers/:id teachers.read Teacher detail

Module 18 · Teacher Subject Mapping

Phase 5 · Teachers · Depends on: M12, M16 · Owns tables: teacher_subjects · Reads: teachers, subjects · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Manages which subjects a teacher teaches, which one is primary, and optional years of experience per subject. Shown and edited on the teacher detail page (Subjects & classes tab).

2. Business Purpose

Subject mapping drives search results, recommendations and analytics ("how many Physics teachers in Pune?"). Admins must be able to correct mappings when teachers pick wrong subjects.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to add "JEE Advanced" to a Physics teacher so that JEE parents find them.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to mark Physics as the primary subject so that it shows first on the teacher card.
  • As Verification Admin, I want to see whether the subjects match the qualification so that I can flag mismatches.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-18.1 List. GET /teachers/:teacherId/subjects returns mapped subjects with category and primary flag.

FR-18.2 Replace set. PUT /teachers/:teacherId/subjects { items: [{ subjectId, isPrimary, experienceYears }] } replaces the whole set in one transaction (diffed: inserts new, deletes removed, updates changed). Exactly one primary when the set is non-empty (if none is marked, the first item becomes primary).

FR-18.3 Limits. 1–10 subjects per teacher; only active subjects; approved teachers must keep at least one subject.

FR-18.4 Side effects. After commit: refresh the teacher's search document, recompute profile completeness (Module 17), and emit teacher.subjects_changed (recommendation cache for parents is invalidated for affected subjects).

FR-18.5 Qualification hint. The UI shows a soft warning when a subject's category is competitive_exam and experience < 2 years, or when the subject is far from the declared qualification (simple keyword rules) — informational only.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
items 1–10 items (0 only for teachers in draft)
subjectId active subject, unique within items
isPrimary at most one true
experienceYears optional, 0–60, ≤ teacher's total experience

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /teachers/:teacherId/subjects teachers.read Current subjects
PUT /teachers/:teacherId/subjects teachers.update Replace subject set

7. Request Payloads

// PUT /teachers/:teacherId/subjects
{ "items": [ { "subjectId": "…physics…", "isPrimary": true, "experienceYears": 14 }, { "subjectId": "…jee-advanced…", "isPrimary": false, "experienceYears": 10 } ], "reason": "Teacher asked to add JEE Advanced" }

8. Response Payloads

// 200 PUT /teachers/:teacherId/subjects
{ "data": { "items": [ { "subjectId": "…", "name": "Physics", "category": "academic", "isPrimary": true, "experienceYears": 14 }, { "subjectId": "…", "name": "JEE Advanced", "category": "competitive_exam", "isPrimary": false, "experienceYears": 10 } ],
  "added": ["JEE Advanced"], "removed": [] } }

Module 19 · Teacher Class Mapping

Phase 5 · Teachers · Depends on: M11, M13, M16 · Owns tables: teacher_classes · Reads: teachers, classes, boards · Build estimate: 1 day

1. Module Overview

Manages which classes a teacher covers and, optionally, for which boards (e.g., Class 11–12 for CBSE and ICSE). Edited in the same Subjects & classes tab as Module 18.

2. Business Purpose

Class coverage is the main input for per-child recommendations (Module 29) — a Class 4 child should only see teachers covering Class 4.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to set a teacher to Class 9–12, CBSE only, so that recommendations are accurate.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to select a range ("Class 6 to 10") in one action so that editing is quick.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-19.1 List. GET /teachers/:teacherId/classes returns rows { class, board|null } plus a compressed summary ("Class 9–12 · CBSE, ICSE").

FR-19.2 Replace set. PUT /teachers/:teacherId/classes { classIds: [...], boardIds: [...] | [] } expands to the cartesian product (each class × each board, or board NULL = any board when boardIds is empty) and replaces the set in one transaction.

FR-19.3 Range helper. The UI offers "from/to" class selectors that fill classIds using level_order.

FR-19.4 Limits. 1–16 classes, 0–5 boards; approved teachers must keep ≥ 1 class. Subjects with a class range (Module 12) must overlap at least one mapped class — otherwise a warning is returned (warnings[]), not an error.

FR-19.5 Side effects. Same as Module 18 (search refresh, completeness, recommendation cache invalidation).

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
classIds 1–16 active classes, unique
boardIds 0–5 active boards, unique
reason optional, ≤ 500 chars

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /teachers/:teacherId/classes teachers.read Current classes and boards
PUT /teachers/:teacherId/classes teachers.update Replace class/board coverage

// PUT /teachers/:teacherId/classes
{ "classIds": ["…class-11…", "…class-12…", "…competitive…"], "boardIds": ["…cbse…"], "reason": "Teacher teaches CBSE only" }

8. Response Payloads

// 200
{ "data": { "summary": "Class 11–12, Competitive exam preparation · CBSE", "rows": [ { "classId": "…", "className": "Class 11", "boardId": "…", "boardName": "CBSE" } ],
  "warnings": [ { "code": "SUBJECT_CLASS_MISMATCH", "message": "Python is usually taught from Class 5; no mapped class overlaps." } ] } }
