Module 20 · Teacher Location Mapping

Phase 5 · Teachers · Depends on: M9, M10, M14, M16 · Owns tables: teacher_locations, teacher_teaching_modes · Reads: teachers, cities, areas, teaching_modes · Build estimate: 2 days

1. Module Overview

Manages where and how a teacher teaches: the cities and areas they serve (with a primary base and travel radius for home tuition) and the teaching modes they offer (Online, At teacher's place, Home tuition, Hybrid, Group batch).

2. Business Purpose

"Nearby" and "home tutor in Koramangala" are the most common parent searches. Correct locations and modes make those results trustworthy; online-only teachers must be visible everywhere without a location.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to set a teacher's base to Koramangala with a 5 km radius for home tuition so that nearby parents see them.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to mark a teacher as online-only so that they appear in every city's online results.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to add a second city for a teacher who teaches in two places.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-20.1 List. GET /teachers/:teacherId/locations returns locations (city, area, primary, radius, address shown to admins only) and modes.

FR-20.2 Replace locations. PUT /teachers/:teacherId/locations { items: [{ cityId, areaId?, isPrimary, travelRadiusKm?, addressLine?, latitude?, longitude? }] } — replace set; exactly one primary when non-empty; area must belong to the city; geocode address or fall back to the area centre (background job fills coordinates).

FR-20.3 Replace modes. PUT /teachers/:teacherId/teaching-modes { modeIds: [...] } — 1–5 active modes.

FR-20.4 Consistency rules.

  • If any mode has requires_location = true, at least one location is required.
  • HOME_TUITION requires travelRadiusKm on the primary location (1–50).
  • Online-only teachers (all modes requires_location = false) may have zero locations; their primary city (for analytics) is taken from the app user profile.
  • Max 3 cities, max 15 area rows per teacher.

FR-20.5 Side effects. Refresh the teacher search document (geo point for distance sorting), recompute completeness, invalidate "nearby" caches for affected areas.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
cityId active city
areaId optional, active area in that city
isPrimary exactly one true when items exist
travelRadiusKm 0–50; required for primary when HOME_TUITION is offered
addressLine ≤ 200 chars; never exposed publicly
latitude/longitude optional, valid ranges, within 50 km of the city centre
modeIds 1–5 active teaching modes, unique

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /teachers/:teacherId/locations teachers.read Locations and modes
PUT /teachers/:teacherId/locations teachers.update Replace locations
PUT /teachers/:teacherId/teaching-modes teachers.update Replace modes

7. Request Payloads

// PUT /teachers/:teacherId/locations
{ "items": [ { "cityId": "…bengaluru…", "areaId": "…koramangala…", "isPrimary": true, "travelRadiusKm": 5, "addressLine": "5th Block, Koramangala" }, { "cityId": "…bengaluru…", "areaId": "…hsr…", "isPrimary": false } ], "reason": "Teacher added HSR" }

// PUT /teachers/:teacherId/teaching-modes
{ "modeIds": ["…online…", "…home_tuition…"] }

8. Response Payloads

// 200 GET /teachers/:teacherId/locations

  "modes": [ { "id": "…", "code": "ONLINE", "name": "Online" }, { "id": "…", "code": "HOME_TUITION", "name": "Home tuition" } ] } }

teacher_locations

Cities and areas a teacher serves, with travel radius for home tuition.

CREATE TABLE teacher_locations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Teacher
  city_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- City served
  area_id uuid REFERENCES areas(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Area; NULL = whole city
  is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Home base shown on the profile (max one)

Module 21 · Teacher Analytics

Phase 5 · Teachers · Depends on: M16, M17 (M33, M38, M39 for full metrics) · Owns tables: teacher_profile_views, teacher_daily_stats · Reads: teachers, leads, demo_requests, teacher_reviews · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Overview

Per-teacher and cross-teacher analytics: profile views, unique viewers, lead requests, demo requests and completions, reviews and rating over time, and conversion from view to lead to demo. Raw view events are recorded by the mobile API; a nightly (and hourly for today) job rolls them up into teacher_daily_stats, which all screens read.

2. Business Purpose

Admins use these numbers to pick featured teachers, spot teachers who ignore leads, and show teachers the value of premium listings. Reading from a roll-up table keeps screens fast regardless of event volume.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to see a teacher's views, leads and conversion for the last 30 days so that I can advise them.
  • As Operations Admin, I want a leaderboard of teachers by lead conversion in a city so that I can choose featured teachers.
  • As Support Admin, I want to see a teacher's response rate so that I can act on "teacher never replies" complaints.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-21.1 Event capture (mobile API contract). POST /api/v1/app/events/profile-view { teacherId, source } inserts into teacher_profile_views (deduplicated: same viewer + teacher within 30 minutes counts once, enforced with a Redis key pv:<viewer>:<teacher> TTL 30 min).

FR-21.2 Roll-up job. analytics-rollup hourly for today and nightly (01:00 IST) for yesterday: INSERT … ON CONFLICT (teacher_id, stat_date) DO UPDATE with counts from teacher_profile_views, leads, demo_requests and teacher_reviews. Re-runnable for any date range (POST /teacher-analytics/rebuild { from, to }, super admin).

FR-21.3 Teacher metrics. GET /teachers/:id/analytics?from&to&granularity=day|week|month returns series and totals: views, unique viewers, leads, demo requests, demos completed, reviews, average rating (rating_sum / reviews), view→lead %, lead→demo %, demo→completion %, response rate (leads with first_response_at within 24 h / leads), median first response time.

FR-21.4 Leaderboard. GET /teacher-analytics/leaderboard?cityId&subjectId&metric=leads|conversion|rating|views&from&to — top 50 approved, active teachers; conversion metrics require ≥ 20 views to qualify.

FR-21.5 Source breakdown. Views by source for a teacher (search, featured, recommended, nearby, shared link, institute page).

FR-21.6 Retention. Raw teacher_profile_views older than 13 months are deleted monthly (roll-ups are kept forever).

5. Validation Rules

Param Rule
from / to dates, to ≥ from, span ≤ 366 days (≤ 90 days for granularity=day)
granularity day, week, month
metric leads, conversion, rating, views
cityId / subjectId optional active ids

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /teachers/:id/analytics teacher_analytics.read Series + totals for one teacher
GET /teachers/:id/analytics/sources teacher_analytics.read Views by source
GET /teacher-analytics/leaderboard teacher_analytics.read Top teachers by metric
POST /teacher-analytics/rebuild super admin Recompute roll-ups for a date range (async)

// POST /teacher-analytics/rebuild

teacher_profile_views

Raw profile-view events from the app. High volume; partition by month when it exceeds ~50M rows.

CREATE TABLE teacher_profile_views (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Teacher viewed
  viewer_user_id uuid REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Viewer, NULL for signed-out views
  source text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'search' CHECK (source IN ('search','home_featured','home_recommended','nearby','shared_link','institute_page','other')), -- Where the view came from
  city_id uuid REFERENCES cities(id), -- Viewer city at the time
  viewed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- When
);
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_profile_views_teacher ON teacher_profile_views (teacher_id, viewed_at DESC);

teacher_daily_stats

Daily roll-up per teacher, written by a nightly job. All analytics screens read from here.

CREATE TABLE teacher_daily_stats (
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Teacher
  stat_date date NOT NULL, -- Day (Asia/Kolkata)
  profile_views integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Views that day
  unique_viewers integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Distinct signed-in viewers
  lead_requests integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Leads created
  demo_requests integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Demo requests created
  demos_completed integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Demos marked completed
  reviews_published integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Reviews published
  rating_sum integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Sum of star ratings published that day (average = rating_sum / reviews_published)
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last recomputed
  PRIMARY KEY (teacher_id, stat_date)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_daily_stats_date ON teacher_daily_stats (stat_date);

Module 22 · Institute Registration Queue

Phase 6 · Institutes · Depends on: M0–M2, M5, M9, M10 (M25 for the manager shown in the queue) · Owns tables: institutes, institute_documents · Reads: files, cities, areas, institute_managers · Build estimate: 4 days

1. Module Overview

Institutes (coaching centres, tuition centres, schools, music, coding, language and sports academies) register in the app through their manager, upload registration documents and campus photos, pay the institute fee if enabled, and arrive in this queue. Verification Admins review documents one by one (approve, reject, request re-upload) before the institute moves to evaluation and decision (Module 23).

2. Business Purpose

Parents trust an institute listing only if GuruConnect has checked that it legally exists at the stated address. Document review is the first gate; it must be quick and consistent, with a clear record of what was checked.

3. User Stories

  • As a Verification Admin, I want a queue of new institutes with how long each has waited so that I review the oldest first.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to open the registration certificate and PAN side by side with the application so that I can confirm name and address.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to request a better photo of the certificate with a reason so that the manager can fix it in the app.
  • As an Operations Admin, I want to onboard an institute on its behalf so that centres without smartphones can join.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

Status machine (institutes.verification_status) — this module moves an institute from pending to under_review and docs_requested; Module 23 owns the rest.

draft ──manager submits──▶ pending ──admin opens──▶ under_review
under_review ──request documents──▶ docs_requested ──manager re-uploads──▶ pending
under_review ──all required docs approved──▶ (Module 23: visit_scheduled / evaluation_done / approved / rejected)

Required documents: registration_certificate, pan (or gst_certificate), manager_aadhaar, at least 6 campus_photo. Optional: fire_safety_noc, other.

FR-22.1 Queue. GET /institute-verifications — institutes in pending, under_review, docs_requested, visit_scheduled, evaluation_done, oldest first, with type, city, manager, teacher count, documents summary, fee status, age and SLA (target: document review within 48 h, full decision within 5 working days).

FR-22.2 Case detail. GET /institute-verifications/:instituteId — application (name, type, established year, registration number, GSTIN, address, facilities claimed, classrooms, seating, students, courses), manager (Module 25), documents with versions, photos gallery, timeline (Module 23 logs), payment reference.

FR-22.3 Document decisions. POST /institute-documents/:id/approve, /reject { reasonCode, note }, /request-reupload { reasonCode, note } — same rules as Module 16 (current version only; notes shown to the manager).

FR-22.4 Send back. POST /institute-verifications/:instituteId/request-documents { message } sets docs_requested and notifies the primary manager (push + SMS + email) listing items and reasons. Re-uploads create new versions and return the institute to pending.

FR-22.5 Automated checks. GSTIN format + checksum and (when an API key is configured) GST portal lookup of legal name and address; PIN code matches the area; registration-number format per state; duplicate detection by GSTIN, registration number and phone across institutes. Results appear in the case as pass/warn/fail.

FR-22.6 Manual onboarding. POST /institutes (institutes.update) creates the institute in draft with a primary manager invite (Module 25) and lets the admin upload documents. Another admin must make the final decision (Module 23).

FR-22.7 Slug & code. public_code GC-I + 4-digit sequence; slug from name + area (apex-jee-academy-koramangala), unique.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
name 3–120 chars
instituteType enum
establishedYear 1800 … current year
registrationNumber 4–40 chars, [A-Za-z0-9/-]
gstin optional, ^\d{2}[A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$ + checksum; first two digits must match the state's GST code
phone E.164; email optional valid; website https
address addressLine 5–200; cityId active; areaId in city; pincode 6 digits
facilities from the facilities list (ac_classrooms, cctv, library, science_lab, computer_lab, test_centre, parking, wheelchair_access, drinking_water, separate_washrooms, sound_proof_rooms, instrument_library, sports_ground, other)
classrooms 0–500; seatingCapacity 0–20,000; studentCount 0–100,000
document decisions as Module 16 (reason code + 10–500-char note for reject/re-upload)

9. PostgreSQL Tables

institutes

Coaching centres, tuition centres, schools and academies. Rated by GuruConnect after verification.

CREATE TABLE institutes (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  public_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT ('GC-I' || nextval('seq_institute_code')), -- Human-friendly id, e.g. GC-I2101
  name text NOT NULL, -- Institute name
  slug text NOT NULL, -- URL slug for the public page
  institute_type text NOT NULL CHECK (institute_type IN ('coaching_centre','tuition_centre','school','music_school','coding_academy','language_institute','sports_academy','other')), -- Type
  established_year smallint CHECK (established_year BETWEEN 1800 AND 2100), -- Year founded
  registration_number text, -- Shop & Establishment / Trust / Society registration number
  gstin text, -- 15-char GSTIN, optional
  email citext, -- Official email
  phone text NOT NULL, -- Official phone (E.164)
  website text, -- https URL
  address_line text NOT NULL, -- Street address
  city_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- City
  area_id uuid REFERENCES areas(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Area
  pincode text CHECK (pincode ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{5}$'), -- 6-digit PIN
  latitude numeric(9,6), -- Geocoded latitude
  longitude numeric(9,6), -- Geocoded longitude
  about text, -- Description, max 3,000 chars
  logo_file_id uuid REFERENCES files(id), -- Logo
  cover_file_id uuid REFERENCES files(id), -- Cover photo
  facilities text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- Claimed facilities, e.g. {ac_classrooms, cctv, library}
  classrooms smallint CHECK (classrooms >= 0), -- Number of classrooms
  seating_capacity integer CHECK (seating_capacity >= 0), -- Total seats
  student_count integer CHECK (student_count >= 0), -- Approximate current students
  fee_min_paise bigint, -- Lowest course fee
  fee_max_paise bigint, -- Highest course fee
  verification_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (verification_status IN ('draft','pending','under_review','docs_requested','visit_scheduled','evaluation_done','approved','rejected')), -- Workflow state
  account_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (account_status IN ('active','suspended')), -- Suspended institutes are hidden
  is_verified_badge boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Verified Institute badge
  overall_rating numeric(2,1) CHECK (overall_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), -- Current GuruConnect rating (cached from institute_ratings)
  infrastructure_score numeric(3,1) CHECK (infrastructure_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10), -- Cached from the current rating
  faculty_score numeric(3,1) CHECK (faculty_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10), -- Cached from the current rating
  user_rating_avg numeric(3,2), -- Cached average of published institute reviews
  user_rating_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- Cached count of published reviews
  is_premium boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Premium listing
  premium_until timestamptz, -- Premium expiry
  registration_transaction_id uuid, -- Registration fee payment (FK added in migration 040)
  submitted_at timestamptz, -- Submitted for review
  approved_at timestamptz, -- Approved
  approved_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Approver
  rejected_at timestamptz, -- Rejected
  rejection_reason_code text, -- e.g. FAKE_REGISTRATION, ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND
  rejection_note text, -- Message to the institute
  created_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Admin creator (manual onboarding)
  updated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last admin editor
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Last updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Who deleted
  CONSTRAINT ck_institutes_fee_range CHECK (fee_min_paise IS NULL OR fee_max_paise IS NULL OR fee_min_paise <= fee_max_paise)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_institutes_public_code ON institutes (public_code);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_institutes_slug ON institutes (slug) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_queue ON institutes (verification_status, submitted_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_city ON institutes (city_id, area_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_institutes_name_trgm ON institutes USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_institutes_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON institutes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();
ALTER TABLE institutes ADD CONSTRAINT fk_institutes_registration_txn FOREIGN KEY (registration_transaction_id) REFERENCES transactions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

institute_documents

Institute verification documents and campus photos, versioned like teacher documents.

CREATE TABLE institute_documents (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  institute_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Owner
  doc_type text NOT NULL CHECK (doc_type IN ('registration_certificate','pan','gst_certificate','manager_aadhaar','campus_photo','fire_safety_noc','other')), -- Type
  file_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES files(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Stored file
  caption text, -- e.g. Classroom A (for campus photos)
  doc_number_masked text, -- Masked number for display
  version smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- Upload count for this type
  is_current boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- false once replaced
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitted' CHECK (status IN ('submitted','approved','rejected','reupload_requested')), -- Review state
  review_note text, -- Reason shown to the institute manager
  reviewed_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Reviewer
  reviewed_at timestamptz, -- Review time
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Uploaded
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Last updated
);
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_documents_institute ON institute_documents (institute_id, doc_type) WHERE is_current;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_institute_documents_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON institute_documents FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 23 · Institute Verification

Phase 6 · Institutes · Depends on: M22, M25, M27 · Owns tables: institute_verification_logs · Reads: institutes, institute_documents, institute_ratings, institute_managers · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Overview

The decision step for institutes after document review: schedule and record the evaluation (site visit or video walkthrough), then Approve (verify and publish with the Verified Institute badge) or Reject. Keeps the full verification timeline.

2. Business Purpose

Institutes affect many families at once. GuruConnect's promise is that a verified institute exists, is safe and has qualified teachers — so approval requires documents plus a completed evaluation and an assigned rating.

3. User Stories

  • As a Verification Admin, I want to schedule a site visit with the manager so that I can check the campus.
  • As Super Admin (Sameer Bhaiya), I want to approve an institute only after its rating is submitted so that every verified institute shows a rating.
  • As a Verification Admin, I want to reject an institute with a clear reason so that the manager knows what to fix.
  • As Super Admin, I want to revoke an institute's badge if serious complaints are upheld.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

Status machine (continued from Module 22)

under_review ──all required docs approved──▶ under_review (docs complete flag)
under_review ──schedule visit──▶ visit_scheduled ──visit recorded + rating submitted (M27)──▶ evaluation_done
evaluation_done ──approve──▶ approved        (any review state) ──reject──▶ rejected
approved ──suspend/activate (M24) changes account_status; badge revoke keeps status approved
rejected ──manager may re-apply after 30 days──▶ draft

FR-23.1 Schedule evaluation. POST /institute-verifications/:id/schedule-visit { method: site_visit|video_walkthrough, visitAt, assignedAdminId, note } — requires all required documents approved; sets visit_scheduled; notifies the manager with date/time and what to prepare (classrooms, fire exits, washrooms, registers); calendar invite (ICS) emailed to the assigned admin. Reschedule with the same endpoint (logged).

FR-23.2 Record visit. POST /institute-verifications/:id/visit-completed { visitedAt, note } logs visit_completed. The evaluation itself is entered in Module 27; submitting a rating moves the institute to evaluation_done (Module 27 calls this module's service).

FR-23.3 Approve. POST /institute-verifications/:id/approve { grantBadge: true, note } (institute_verification.decide). Preconditions: required documents approved; a submitted current rating exists (Module 27); primary manager active; not suspended. Effects: approved, approved_at/by, badge, cache the rating fields on institutes, make public, notify manager, start the institute registration period (Module 41) if paid, emit institute.approved (referrals, Module 42).

FR-23.4 Reject. POST /institute-verifications/:id/reject { reasonCode, note } — reason codes FAKE_REGISTRATION, ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND, UNSAFE_PREMISES, UNQUALIFIED_FACULTY, DUPLICATE, DOCS_NOT_PROVIDED, OTHER. Refund per fee rules (Module 40, reason institute_rejected). FAKE_REGISTRATION also suspends the manager's app account.

FR-23.5 Badge. POST /institutes/:id/badge { grant, reason } — revoke/grant for approved institutes (e.g., after upheld complaints).

FR-23.6 Timeline. GET /institute-verifications/:id/timeline — all institute_verification_logs entries with actor and notes; notes can be internal or visible to the manager (POST …/notes).

FR-23.7 Re-evaluation. Approved institutes are re-evaluated every 12 months (institute_ratings.next_review_due). A daily job lists due institutes in the queue with status unchanged (still approved) and flag re_evaluation_due.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
method site_visit or video_walkthrough
visitAt future (≤ 60 days) when scheduling; past (≤ 7 days ago) for visit-completed
assignedAdminId active admin holding institute_ratings.rate
reasonCode list above; note 10–500 chars (shown to manager)
grantBadge boolean, default true
Preconditions as in FR-23.1 and FR-23.3

Module 24 · Institute Profile Management

Phase 6 · Institutes · Depends on: M22, M23 · Owns tables: institute_batches · Reads: institutes, files, cities, areas, subjects, classes, teaching_modes · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Overview

The admin directory of institutes and the institute detail page: edit profile data (about, contact, address, facilities, fees, photos), manage courses and batches shown on the public profile, suspend or re-activate, set premium listing, and see tabs for managers (25), teachers (26), ratings (27), reviews (34), leads (38) and complaints (43).

2. Business Purpose

Institutes change timings, fees and batches often; managers do this in the app, but support must be able to correct data, handle takedown requests and suspend an institute during an investigation.

3. User Stories

  • As Operations Admin, I want to fix an institute's address and PIN so that it appears in the right area.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to add a "JEE 2027 weekend batch" with seats and fee so that parents see accurate batches.
  • As Support Admin, I want to suspend an institute during a fraud investigation so that it stops getting enquiries.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to list all verified institutes in Pune with their rating so that I can plan a campaign.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-24.1 Directory. GET /institutes — name, code, type, city/area, manager, teachers count, verification status, account status, overall rating, infrastructure/faculty scores, user rating, premium flag, created date. Export like Module 17.

FR-24.2 Detail. GET /institutes/:id — full profile, cached rating fields, counts (teachers active, batches, leads 30d, reviews, open complaints), current subscription.

FR-24.3 Edit. PATCH /institutes/:id (If-Match) for name*, type, established year, registration number*, GSTIN*, contact (phone, email, website), address* (line, city, area, PIN, coordinates), about, logo, cover, facilities, classrooms, seating, student count, fee range. Starred fields on an approved institute require a reason and add a profile_changed_after_approval log; changing address city or facilities flags the next evaluation as due (re_evaluation_due).

FR-24.4 Batches. CRUD on institute_batches (soft delete). Each batch: name, subjects, class, mode, schedule text, seats total/available, fee and period, start date, active. Max 50 active batches per institute.

FR-24.5 Suspend / activate. Same behaviour as Module 17 applied to institutes: hidden from search, open leads marked unavailable, upcoming campus visits/demos cancelled, managers notified; optional auto re-activate date.

FR-24.6 Premium (manual). POST /institutes/:id/premium { premium, until, reason }.

FR-24.7 Photos. PUT /institutes/:id/photos sets the public gallery order from approved campus_photo documents (max 20); the cover must be one of them or a separate upload.

5. Validation Rules

Profile fields as Module 22. Batches: name 3–80; subjectIds 1–6 active subjects; classId active; seatsTotal 1–1,000; seatsAvailable 0…seatsTotal; feePaise 0…1,00,00,000; feePeriod enum; startsOn ≥ today − 365 days; schedule text ≤ 120. Suspend reason 10–500; until ≤ 365 days.

9. PostgreSQL Tables

institute_batches

Courses and batches an institute runs, shown on its public profile.

CREATE TABLE institute_batches (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  institute_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Institute
  name text NOT NULL, -- e.g. JEE 2027 · Class 12
  subject_ids uuid[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- Subjects covered (validated against subjects in the API)
  class_id uuid REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Target class
  teaching_mode_id uuid REFERENCES teaching_modes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Mode
  schedule_text text, -- e.g. Weekdays 4–7 PM
  seats_total integer CHECK (seats_total >= 0), -- Capacity
  seats_available integer CHECK (seats_available >= 0), -- Remaining seats
  fee_paise bigint CHECK (fee_paise >= 0), -- Course fee
  fee_period text CHECK (fee_period IN ('one_time','monthly','quarterly','yearly')), -- Fee period
  starts_on date, -- Start date
  is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, -- Shown on profile
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  CONSTRAINT ck_institute_batches_seats CHECK (seats_total IS NULL OR seats_available IS NULL OR seats_available <= seats_total)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_institute_batches_inst ON institute_batches (institute_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_institute_batches_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON institute_batches FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 25 · Institute Manager Accounts

Phase 6 · Institutes · Depends on: M22 · Owns tables: institute_managers · Reads: institutes, app_users · Build estimate: 2 days

1. Module Overview

Manages the app accounts that act for an institute: exactly one active primary manager (full control, including teachers) and optional counsellors (enquiries only). Admins can view them, resend invites, disable accounts and — for ownership disputes or staff changes — replace the primary manager.

2. Business Purpose

The requirement is explicit: only the institute manager can manage institute teachers in the app. That rule depends on knowing, reliably, who the manager is. Admins need a safe, audited way to change it when an institute's ownership or staff changes.

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want to see who manages an institute and who the counsellors are so that I can verify a caller.
  • As Super Admin, I want to replace the primary manager when the centre head leaves so that the new head can manage teachers.
  • As Support Admin, I want to disable a counsellor who misused enquiries so that they lose access immediately.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-25.1 Roles (app-side enforcement contract).

Capability in the app Manager Counsellor
View/respond to enquiries, assign to teacher ✓ ✓
Edit institute profile, batches, photos ✓ —
Add / edit / remove institute teachers, assign subjects & classes ✓ —
Invite / remove counsellors ✓ —
Billing and registration fee ✓ —
The mobile API checks institute_managers.staff_role = 'manager' (and status = 'active') for every teacher-management endpoint (Module 26); this module is where admins see and change those roles.

FR-25.2 List & detail. GET /institutes/:id/managers — name, phone (masked), email, role, primary flag, status, invited/accepted dates, last active (from app_users).

FR-25.3 Resend invite. For invited staff, sends a new SMS/email deep link (72 h).

FR-25.4 Disable / enable. POST /institute-managers/:id/disable { reason } — revokes their app sessions for this institute; the primary manager cannot be disabled unless a replacement is set in the same request.

FR-25.5 Replace primary. POST /institutes/:id/managers/replace-primary { newManager: { existingStaffId | fullName, phone, email }, reason, evidenceFileId? } (institute_managers.manage, sensitive): in one transaction the old primary becomes is_primary = false, staff_role = 'counsellor' or disabled (choice), the new person becomes primary manager (invite sent if new); both notified. Evidence (authorisation letter on letterhead) is recommended for ownership changes.

FR-25.6 Change role. POST /institute-managers/:id/role { staffRole } — promote a counsellor to manager (non-primary managers allowed, max 3 managers) or demote.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
fullName 2–100; phone E.164 (unique among active staff of the institute); email optional
staffRole manager or counsellor; max 3 active managers and 10 counsellors per institute
reason 10–500 chars for disable, replace, role change
evidenceFileId optional uploaded private document

6. API Endpoints

POST /institute-managers/:staffId/role institute_managers.manage Change role

Module 26 · Institute Teacher Management

Phase 6 · Institutes · Depends on: M22, M25, M11, M12 · Owns tables: institute_teachers, institute_teacher_subjects, institute_teacher_classes · Reads: institutes, teachers, institute_managers, subjects, classes · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Overview

Teachers listed under an institute. In the app, only the institute manager can add, edit or remove them and assign their subjects and classes; each added teacher receives an SMS link to complete their own Aadhaar/PAN check. In the admin portal, staff can view every institute's teacher list and, with a support-override permission, correct or remove entries.

2. Business Purpose

Parents judge an institute by its faculty. The list must be accurate and verified, and only accountable people (the manager, or GuruConnect admins) may change it.

3. User Stories

  • As a Verification Admin, I want to see which institute teachers have completed their ID check so that I can rate faculty quality.
  • As Support Admin, I want to remove a teacher who has left but is still listed, after the institute ignores requests, so that the profile is honest.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to link an institute teacher to their existing GuruConnect teacher profile so that their trust score shows on the institute page.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-26.1 App rules (contract for the mobile API).

  • Only institute_managers with staff_role = 'manager' and status = 'active' can call add/edit/remove/assign endpoints; counsellors get 403.
  • Adding a teacher: name, phone, qualification, experience, photo, subjects (1–6), classes (1–10), schedule, visibility. If the phone matches an approved GuruConnect teacher, the manager is offered to link (teacher must accept in their app).
  • On add, an SMS invite asks the teacher to verify identity (Aadhaar/PAN) through a lightweight flow; until done, status = 'id_pending' and the teacher shows on the profile without the Verified tick (and only if is_visible).
  • Removing sets status = 'removed', removed_at, reason; the row stays for history.
  • Limit: limits.institute_max_teachers (Module 4) active teachers.

FR-26.2 Admin list. GET /institutes/:id/teachers — name, linked teacher code (if any), subjects, classes, ID status, visible, added by (manager name), added date, trust score of linked teacher.

FR-26.3 Admin override. With institute_teachers.manage: edit fields, change visibility, remove, link/unlink to a teacher profile. Every override requires a reason and notifies the primary manager ("GuruConnect support updated …").

FR-26.4 ID status sync. When the invited person completes verification (approved by Module 16's lightweight flow or by linking to an approved teacher), status becomes active. Faculty stats used by Module 27 (count, % qualified, average experience, average linked trust score) are computed from active rows.

FR-26.5 Cross-institute view. GET /institute-teachers?phone= (support) shows every institute listing that phone — detects the same teacher listed at many centres.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
fullName 2–100
phone E.164, unique among non-removed teachers of the institute
qualification ≤ 120; experienceYears 0–60
subjectIds 1–6 active subjects; classIds 1–10 active classes
scheduleText ≤ 120
reason (admin override) 10–500 chars
teacherId (link) approved, active teacher; not already linked to this institute

Module 27 · Institute Rating System

Phase 6 · Institutes · Depends on: M22, M23, M26 (M34 and M43 feed two criteria) · Owns tables: institute_ratings · Reads: institutes, institute_teachers, institute_reviews, complaints · Build estimate: 3–4 days

1. Module Overview

Sameer Bhaiya (or an admin with institute_ratings.rate) evaluates each institute on four criteria — Infrastructure, Faculty Quality, Student Feedback and Trustworthiness — each scored 0–10 with sub-criteria, and assigns an Overall Rating from 1 to 5 in half steps. The system suggests an overall rating from the scores; the admin can deviate with a reason. Ratings are versioned; the current submitted version is shown publicly on the institute profile with the infrastructure score and the Verified badge.

2. Business Purpose

User reviews alone can be gamed and are sparse for new institutes. A GuruConnect evaluation gives parents an independent, explainable quality signal and makes the Verified badge mean something.

3. User Stories

  • As Super Admin, I want to score infrastructure sub-criteria during a visit on my laptop so that the evaluation is consistent.
  • As Super Admin, I want the system to pre-fill student feedback from reviews and trustworthiness from documents and complaints so that I only adjust.
  • As Super Admin, I want to see the suggested rating and choose the final one so that judgement stays with me.
  • As Super Admin, I want every past evaluation kept so that I can compare this year with last year.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-27.1 Criteria and sub-criteria (each 0–10, half steps).

Criterion Sub-criteria (average = criterion score) Pre-fill source
Infrastructure Classrooms & seating · Safety (CCTV, fire exits, first aid) · Library, labs & test hall · Accessibility & location · Hygiene, water, washrooms Manual
Faculty quality Qualified faculty (% PG/B.Ed.) · Teaching experience · Demo class audit · Average trust score of linked teachers (auto, /10) Module 26 stats (auto values editable except trust average)
Student feedback Published review average scaled to 10 (Bayesian: (C·m + Σr)/(C + n) with C = 10, m = 4.0) · Response to reviews · Complaint-free rate Module 34 + 43, editable with reason
Trustworthiness Documents authenticity · Fee transparency · Complaint history (upheld complaints in 12 months) · Registration age Module 22 + 43

FR-27.2 Suggested rating. suggested = round_half( 1 + 4 × (0.30·Infra + 0.30·Faculty + 0.20·Feedback + 0.20·Trust) / 10 ), where round_half rounds to the nearest 0.5 and the result is clamped to 1–5. Weights live in system_settings key institutes.rating_weights (JSON) and are copied into criteria.weights of each rating for reproducibility.

FR-27.3 Draft & submit. POST /institutes/:id/ratings creates a draft (version = max + 1) pre-filled per FR-27.1. PATCH /institute-ratings/:ratingId autosaves the draft. POST /institute-ratings/:ratingId/submit { overallRating, overrideReason?, publicSummary? }:

  • If |overall − suggested| > 0.5, overrideReason (20–500 chars) is required.
  • In one transaction: previous current rating → is_current = false, status = 'superseded'; new → submitted, is_current = true, submitted_at, next_review_due = today + 12 months; cache overall_rating, infrastructure_score, faculty_score on institutes; call Module 23 to move visit_scheduled → evaluation_done if applicable.
  • If the institute is already approved, the new rating is public immediately (manager notified with the summary).

FR-27.4 Compare. GET /institutes/:id/ratings lists versions; GET /institute-ratings/:ratingId shows details; the UI can diff two versions.

FR-27.5 Public display contract. The app shows: overall rating (x.x / 5), infrastructure score (x.x / 10), faculty score (x.x / 10), evaluation method and date, public summary, Verified badge — never the private notes or sub-scores other than those listed.

FR-27.6 Re-evaluation reminders. Daily job: institutes whose current rating next_review_due ≤ today + 14 appear in the queue filter "Re-evaluation due" and trigger an email to raters.

FR-27.7 Leaderboard. GET /institute-ratings/leaderboard?cityId&type — top-rated approved institutes (used for featured institute rails later).

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
evaluationMethod site_visit, video_walkthrough, document_only (document_only allowed only for re-evaluations without facility changes)
visitAt ≤ now, ≥ now − 30 days
each sub-score number 0–10 in 0.5 steps
overallRating 1–5 in 0.5 steps
overrideReason required when deviation > 0.5; 20–500 chars
notes ≤ 4,000 chars (internal)
publicSummary ≤ 200 chars, no contact details
Preconditions institute not rejected/deleted; only one draft per institute; rater has institute_ratings.rate

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /institutes/:id/ratings institute_ratings.read Rating versions
POST /institutes/:id/ratings institute_ratings.rate Start a draft (pre-filled)
GET /institute-ratings/:ratingId institute_ratings.read One rating with criteria
PATCH /institute-ratings/:ratingId institute_ratings.rate Update draft (If-Match)
POST /institute-ratings/:ratingId/submit institute_ratings.rate Submit and make current
DELETE /institute-ratings/:ratingId institute_ratings.rate Discard a draft
GET /institute-ratings/leaderboard institute_ratings.read Top-rated institutes

9. PostgreSQL Tables

institute_ratings

Evaluations by GuruConnect admins. The latest submitted version is current and drives the public rating.

CREATE TABLE institute_ratings (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  institute_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Institute
  version integer NOT NULL, -- 1, 2, 3… per institute (re-evaluations)
  evaluation_method text NOT NULL CHECK (evaluation_method IN ('site_visit','video_walkthrough','document_only')), -- How it was evaluated
  visit_at timestamptz, -- When the visit happened
  infrastructure_score numeric(3,1) NOT NULL CHECK (infrastructure_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10), -- Classrooms, safety, labs, accessibility, hygiene
  faculty_quality_score numeric(3,1) NOT NULL CHECK (faculty_quality_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10), -- Qualifications, experience, teacher trust, demo audit
  student_feedback_score numeric(3,1) NOT NULL CHECK (student_feedback_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10), -- Derived from published reviews, adjustable by admin
  trustworthiness_score numeric(3,1) NOT NULL CHECK (trustworthiness_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10), -- Documents, complaint history, fee transparency
  criteria jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, -- Sub-scores, e.g. {"infrastructure":{"classrooms":9,"safety":8}}
  suggested_rating numeric(2,1) NOT NULL CHECK (suggested_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), -- Computed by the formula
  overall_rating numeric(2,1) NOT NULL CHECK (overall_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5 AND overall_rating * 2 = round(overall_rating * 2)), -- Final rating in half steps, chosen by the admin
  override_reason text, -- Required when overall differs from suggested by more than 0.5
  notes text, -- Reviewer notes (internal)
  public_summary text, -- Optional line shown on the profile
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft','submitted','superseded')), -- draft is editable; submitted is final
  is_current boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- The rating shown publicly
  rated_by uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES admins(id), -- Evaluator
  submitted_at timestamptz, -- When finalised
  next_review_due date, -- Re-evaluation date (default +12 months)
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Updated
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_institute_ratings_version ON institute_ratings (institute_id, version);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_institute_ratings_current ON institute_ratings (institute_id) WHERE is_current;

Module 28 · Parent Management

Phase 7 · Parents · Depends on: M0–M2, M9, M10 · Owns tables: parents · Reads: app_users, cities, areas, states · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Overview

Admin directory and detail view of parent accounts: profile, location, children summary (Module 29), subscription (Module 30), leads and demos, reviews written, complaints (as reporter or reported), payments and an activity log. Admins can edit profile fields, suspend/re-activate and soft-delete parents.

2. Business Purpose

Support must resolve parent issues quickly ("I paid but can't contact teachers"), and safety staff must be able to stop an abusive parent from contacting teachers. One consolidated parent page avoids hunting through modules.

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want to search a parent by phone and see their subscription and last payments so that I can answer a billing call.
  • As Support Admin, I want to suspend a parent reported for harassment so that they can't contact teachers.
  • As Operations Admin, I want to filter parents by city and subscription status so that I can plan campaigns.
  • As Super Admin, I want to process an account-deletion request so that we meet privacy obligations.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-28.1 Directory. GET /parents — name, code, masked phone, email, city/area, children count and classes, subscription status (trial/active/expired/free), lifetime spend, leads count, last active, account status, joined.

FR-28.2 Detail. GET /parents/:id — profile, children (M29), current subscription (M30), counts, recent activity. Tabs call their modules: Leads & demos (M38–39), Reviews (M33–34 by author), Payments (M40 by user), Referrals (M42), Complaints (M43 both directions), Activity (audit + app events).

FR-28.3 Edit. PATCH /parents/:id (If-Match): full name, email, state, city, area. Phone changes are not allowed from the portal (OTP-verified in the app); support can initiate a "change number" flow that sends an OTP to the new number (POST /parents/:id/change-phone-request).

FR-28.4 Suspend / activate. POST /parents/:id/suspend { reason, complaintId?, until? } — sets account_status = 'suspended' on parents and app_users, revokes app sessions, cancels pending demo requests (learners' side), hides their pending reviews; subscription time is not refunded automatically (Finance decides via Module 40). activate reverses.

FR-28.5 Delete (privacy). DELETE /parents/:id { reason, requestSource: user_request|admin } (super admin): soft-deletes parent, children and app user; a job after 30 days anonymises PII (name → "Deleted user", phone/email nulled) while retaining transactions (8-year tax retention) and complaint records.

FR-28.6 PII masking. Phone/email masked unless the admin holds users.pii; POST /parents/:id/reveal-contact returns full values and audits parent.pii_viewed.

FR-28.7 Public code. GC-P + 5-digit sequence, generated on creation.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
fullName 2–100
email valid, unique among live app users
stateId / cityId / areaId active; area within city; city within state
suspend.reason 10–500; until ≤ 365 days
delete.reason 10–500

PATCH /parents/:id parents.update Edit profile

DELETE /parents/:id super admin Delete account (privacy)

Module 29 · Parent Children Management

Phase 7 · Parents · Depends on: M28, M11–M15 · Owns tables: parent_children, parent_child_subjects, parent_child_teacher_categories · Reads: parents, classes, boards, subjects, teacher_categories, teaching_modes · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Overview

Each parent can add multiple children (up to the limits.parent_max_children setting, default 3) with the child's first name, class, board, subjects needed, types of teacher wanted and preferred mode. The app uses these to show per-child recommendations. The admin portal shows children on the parent page, lets support correct them, and exposes aggregate demand ("how many Class 10 CBSE children need Maths in Pune?").

2. Business Purpose

Per-child preferences are the input to GuruConnect's recommendation engine. Admins need visibility for support and aggregated demand data to decide which teachers to recruit where.

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want to see a parent's children with class and needs so that I can explain why certain teachers were recommended.
  • As Operations Admin, I want demand counts by class, subject and city so that I can recruit teachers where demand is unmet.
  • As Support Admin, I want to fix a child's class when a parent picked the wrong one so that recommendations improve immediately.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-29.1 Children of a parent. GET /parents/:parentId/children returns children with class, board, subjects, teacher categories, preferred mode, created date.

FR-29.2 Edit / remove (support). PATCH /parent-children/:childId (reason required) and DELETE /parent-children/:childId (soft). The parent is notified in-app that support updated their preferences.

FR-29.3 Rules (shared with the mobile API).

  • 1 … limits.parent_max_children children per parent (default 3).
  • child_name: first name only, 1–40 chars (data minimisation for minors; no date of birth, no photo).
  • Subjects must be offered for the child's class (Module 12 class range); changing the class drops subjects that no longer fit.
  • 0–6 subjects, 0–4 teacher categories; preferred mode optional.

FR-29.4 Recommendation contract. For a child, eligible teachers are approved, active, and have a teacher_classes row with the child's class (board NULL or equal). Score = 5 (class) + 3 × (category match) + 3 × (subject match) + 1 × (mode match) + trust_score/100 + 0.5 × (within 4 km of parent's area). Top 20 per child are cached in Redis rec:<childId> for 6 hours and invalidated when the child or matched teacher mappings change. Admin endpoint GET /parent-children/:childId/recommendations shows the same list with the score breakdown for support.

FR-29.5 Demand analytics. GET /children-demand?cityId&classId&subjectId&categoryId returns counts of children (live, not deleted) grouped by the requested dimensions, plus supply (approved teachers matching) and a gap ratio.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
childName 1–40 chars, letters/spaces only
classId active class
boardId optional active board (state boards only in the parent's state or "other")
subjectIds 0–6 active subjects valid for the class
categoryIds 0–4 active teacher categories
preferredModeId optional active mode
reason (support edit) 10–500

6. API Endpoints

Method Path Permission Description
GET /parents/:parentId/children parent_children.read Children of a parent
GET /parent-children/:childId parent_children.read One child
PATCH /parent-children/:childId parent_children.manage Support edit (reason)
DELETE /parent-children/:childId parent_children.manage Remove child (soft)
GET /parent-children/:childId/recommendations parent_children.read Recommendations with score breakdown
GET /children-demand parent_children.read Aggregated demand vs supply

);

Module 30 · Parent Subscription Management

Phase 7 · Parents · Depends on: M5, M28, M40, M41 (create the M40–M41 tables before building this module's API) · Owns tables: none · Reads: subscriptions, transactions, payment_configurations, parents · Build estimate: 2 days

1. Module Overview

The parent-specific view of subscriptions: current plan (trial, monthly, yearly, free access), history, renewals and payments for each parent, plus admin actions — grant complimentary access, extend, cancel, and switch auto-renew off. It is a filtered, parent-focused UI over the shared subscriptions engine owned by Module 41.

2. Business Purpose

Parents call support about trials ending, renewals and refunds. Support and finance need parent-level answers and tools without learning the whole subscription engine.

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want to see when a parent's trial ends and whether auto-renew is on so that I can answer "why was I charged?".
  • As Finance Admin, I want to extend a parent's membership by 15 days after a service failure so that we keep their goodwill.
  • As Finance Admin, I want to cancel auto-renew at a parent's request so that they aren't charged again.
  • As Operations Admin, I want counts of parents by subscription status so that I can track conversion from trial.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-30.1 Parent subscription list. GET /parent-subscriptions — one row per parent's latest subscription (subscriber_type = 'parent'): parent, plan, status, started, ends, trial ends, auto-renew, price paid, last transaction.

FR-30.2 Parent subscription detail. GET /parents/:parentId/subscriptions — all periods (history), related transactions and refunds.

FR-30.3 Admin actions (implemented by Module 41 services, called with subscriber_type = 'parent'):

  • Grant complimentary POST /parents/:parentId/subscriptions/grant { feeCode, days, reason } — creates an active subscription with price_paise = 0, granted_by.
  • Extend POST /subscriptions/:id/extend { days, reason } — adds days to ends_at (active/grace/trial only).
  • Cancel POST /subscriptions/:id/cancel { mode: at_period_end|immediately, reason, refund? } — immediately ends access now; refunds go through Module 40.
  • Auto-renew off POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew { enabled: false, reason } — cancels the Razorpay subscription mandate.

FR-30.4 Fee switched off. When both parent subscription fees are disabled (Module 5), new parents get free_access and the list shows them under "Free access". Re-enabling fees does not remove free_access automatically; a scheduled job converts them to a trial of trial_days starting on the re-enable date and notifies them (behaviour behind the setting subscriptions.free_access_to_trial_on_enable, default true).

FR-30.5 Funnel. GET /parent-subscriptions/stats?from&to — trials started, converted to paid, conversion %, active by plan, churned, MRR from parents.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
feeCode (grant) PARENT_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY or PARENT_SUBSCRIPTION_YEARLY
days 1–365
reason 10–500
cancel.mode at_period_end, immediately
refund optional { amountPaise } ≤ captured − refunded
Preconditions extend/cancel only on trial, active, grace; one live subscription per parent (M41 constraint)

POST /subscriptions/:id/extend parent_subscriptions.manage (for parent subscriptions) Extend
POST /subscriptions/:id/cancel parent_subscriptions.manage Cancel
POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew parent_subscriptions.manage Turn auto-renew off

Module 31 · Student Management

Phase 8 · Students · Depends on: M0–M2, M9–M13, M28 · Owns tables: students · Reads: app_users, classes, boards, cities, areas, parents · Build estimate: 2–3 days

1. Module Overview

Admin directory and detail view of students who signed up themselves (typically Class 9 and above, college students and exam aspirants): class, board, school/college, optional parent link and parent contact, location, subscription (M32), leads, reviews and complaints. Admins can edit, link to a parent account, suspend/activate and delete.

2. Business Purpose

Students are a distinct audience (JEE/NEET aspirants, adult learners) with their own subscriptions and safety considerations. Support and safety teams need the same one-page view as for parents.

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want to find a student by phone and see their class, subscription and leads so that I can help them.
  • As Support Admin, I want to link a student to their parent's account when the parent asks so that the parent sees demo bookings.
  • As Support Admin, I want to suspend a student who sent abusive messages to a teacher.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-31.1 Directory. GET /students — name, code, masked phone, class, board, school, city, parent linked (yes/no), subscription status, leads, last active, account status.

FR-31.2 Detail. GET /students/:id — profile, parent link, subscription, counts; tabs reuse Modules 32, 38–39, 33–34, 40, 42, 43.

FR-31.3 Edit. PATCH /students/:id (If-Match): full name, email, class, board, school name, parent name/phone, city, area.

FR-31.4 Link parent. POST /students/:id/link-parent { parentId, reason } — both accounts must exist; the parent receives an in-app request to confirm; link becomes effective on confirmation (parent_id set). unlink removes it.

FR-31.5 Suspend/activate/delete. Same as Module 28 (shared SuspendUserDialog, same cascade rules).

FR-31.6 Minors. If the student's class is below Class 9 (level_order < 9) at sign-up, the app requires a parent phone and sends a consent SMS; admins see "Parental consent: confirmed / pending". Students with pending consent cannot contact teachers.

FR-31.7 Public code. GC-S + 5-digit sequence.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
fullName 2–100
email valid, unique among live app users
classId / boardId active
schoolName ≤ 120
parentName 2–100 optional; parentPhone E.164 optional (required when class < 9)
cityId / areaId active; area within city
link-parent.parentId live parent, not already linked to this student

9. PostgreSQL Tables

students

Student profile, one per student app account.

CREATE TABLE students (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Login identity
  public_code text NOT NULL DEFAULT ('GC-S' || nextval('seq_student_code')), -- e.g. GC-S50140
  full_name text NOT NULL, -- Name
  email citext, -- Email
  phone text NOT NULL, -- E.164 phone
  class_id uuid REFERENCES classes(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Current class
  board_id uuid REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Board
  school_name text, -- School or college
  parent_id uuid REFERENCES parents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Linked parent account, if any
  parent_link_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (parent_link_status IN ('none','pending','confirmed')), -- Link requested by support or the student; confirmed by the parent in the app
  parent_name text, -- Optional parent name given at sign-up
  parent_phone text, -- Optional parent phone (E.164)
  parental_consent text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required' CHECK (parental_consent IN ('not_required','pending','confirmed','declined')), -- Required for students below Class 9
  parental_consent_at timestamptz, -- When the parent confirmed by SMS link
  city_id uuid REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- City
  area_id uuid REFERENCES areas(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Area
  account_status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (account_status IN ('active','suspended')), -- Account status
  suspension_reason text, -- Internal reason
  suspended_at timestamptz, -- When suspended
  suspended_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Who suspended
  referral_code_used text, -- Code entered at sign-up
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Updated
  deleted_at timestamptz, -- Soft delete
  deleted_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id) -- Admin who deleted
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_students_user ON students (user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_students_public_code ON students (public_code);
CREATE INDEX idx_students_class ON students (class_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_students_city ON students (city_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_students_name_trgm ON students USING gin (full_name gin_trgm_ops);
CREATE TRIGGER trg_students_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON students FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 32 · Student Subscription Management

Phase 8 · Students · Depends on: M5, M31, M40, M41 · Owns tables: none · Reads: subscriptions, transactions, payment_configurations, students · Build estimate: 1–2 days

1. Module Overview

The student-focused view of subscriptions (free trial → paid membership), mirroring Module 30 for subscriber_type = 'student': list, per-student history, funnel stats, and admin actions (grant, extend, cancel, auto-renew off).

2. Business Purpose

Students have their own pricing (Module 5) and trial rules. Finance and support need the same tools as for parents, filtered to students, to answer questions and measure trial-to-paid conversion.

3. User Stories

  • As Finance Admin, I want to see how many student trials converted to paid last month so that I can judge student pricing.
  • As Support Admin, I want to extend an exam aspirant's membership by a week during a platform outage.
  • As Finance Admin, I want to grant a scholarship student complimentary access for a year.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-32.1 Same list, detail, stats and actions as FR-30.1–30.5 with subscriber_type = 'student' and fee codes STUDENT_SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHLY / STUDENT_SUBSCRIPTION_YEARLY.

FR-32.2 Free trial rules for students. Trial length and free contacts come from the active student fee version (trial_days) and system_settings (limits.student_trial_free_contacts, default 5). One trial per phone number and per device fingerprint (app-side); a second account on the same device gets no trial row at all — the app goes straight to the paid plans, and the reason is logged as an app event (trial_blocked: device_reused).

FR-32.3 Scholarship grants. POST /students/:studentId/subscriptions/grant { feeCode, days, reason, programTag: 'scholarship' } — tagged grants are reported separately in the funnel.

FR-32.4 Parent-linked students. If a linked parent has an active parent membership, the student inherits contact access (read-only indicator "Covered by parent's plan"); no student subscription is required.

5. Validation Rules

As Module 30, with student fee codes; programTag optional one of scholarship, goodwill, partner.

POST /subscriptions/:id/auto-renew student_subscriptions.manage Turn auto-renew off

Module 33 · Teacher Reviews

Phase 9 · Reviews · Depends on: M16, M28, M31 (M35 moderates, M36 consumes) · Owns tables: teacher_reviews · Reads: teachers, app_users, parent_children, leads, demo_requests · Build estimate: 3 days

1. Module Overview

Reviews of teachers written by registered parents and students: a 1–5 star rating, written feedback, the reviewer's role (Parent Review or Student Review), a verified-interaction flag, and the teacher's public reply. This module gives admins the list and detail of teacher reviews, per-teacher rating summaries, and keeps the cached rating_avg/rating_count on teachers correct. Moderation actions live in Module 35.

2. Business Purpose

Reviews are half of the trust promise. Admins need to see every review a teacher has (including rejected ones), understand how ratings are computed, and trust that only genuine, moderated reviews affect ratings and trust scores.

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want to see all reviews of a teacher with their status so that I can answer "why was my review not published?".
  • As Operations Admin, I want a teacher's rating summary split by parents and students so that I can spot mismatches.
  • As Verification Admin, I want to know whether a reviewer actually had a demo or lead with the teacher so that I can weigh the review.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-33.1 Business rules (enforced by the mobile API; shown here because admins must understand them).

  • Only registered parents and students with an active account can review; one review per (teacher, author) — editing replaces it.
  • A review requires a completed demo or a lead older than 3 days with the teacher (is_verified_interaction = true); reviews without interaction are allowed only when settings reviews.allow_unverified = true (default false).
  • Text 30–1,500 chars (min from limits.review_min_chars); rating 1–5.
  • New and edited reviews start as pending. Auto-moderation (Module 35) may publish automatically when spam score < 0.15 and no auto flags, otherwise it waits for a moderator.
  • Author edits allowed within 90 days; edits reset status to pending and set edited_at.
  • Teacher replies (one per review, ≤ 1,000 chars) are moderated (reply_status).

FR-33.2 Rating cache. On every transition into or out of published, recompute in the same transaction: teachers.rating_avg = avg(rating), rating_count = count(*) of published, non-deleted reviews, then enqueue trust recalculation (Module 36, trigger review_published / review_removed).

FR-33.3 Lists. GET /teacher-reviews (all teachers) and GET /teachers/:id/reviews with status and role filters; each item shows teacher, author (name initial + role), child class if parent, stars, text, spam score, auto flags, verified interaction, reply and reply status, dates.

FR-33.4 Summary. GET /teachers/:id/reviews/summary — average (overall, parents, students), distribution 1–5, count by status, reply rate, Bayesian-smoothed rating used by trust (Module 36).

FR-33.5 Author view. GET /app-users/:userId/reviews — every review written by a user (teacher and institute reviews), used to spot serial reviewers.

FR-33.6 Deletion. Author deletion (app) soft-deletes; admins hide via Module 35 rather than delete.

5. Validation Rules

Query: status (pending, published, rejected, flagged, hidden), authorType (parent, student), rating 1–5, hasReply, verifiedInteraction, spamScoreMin 0–1, date range ≤ 366 days.

teacher_reviews

Reviews of teachers by parents and students. Only published reviews count toward ratings and trust.

CREATE TABLE teacher_reviews (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  teacher_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- Teacher reviewed
  author_user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, -- Reviewer
  author_type text NOT NULL CHECK (author_type IN ('parent','student')), -- Reviewer role at the time
  child_id uuid REFERENCES parent_children(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Child the parent is reviewing for
  rating smallint NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), -- Stars
  comment text NOT NULL, -- Review text, 30–1,500 chars
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','published','rejected','flagged','hidden')), -- Moderation state
  spam_score numeric(4,3) CHECK (spam_score BETWEEN 0 AND 1), -- Automated spam probability
  auto_flags text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', -- e.g. {contact_info, repeated_text, rating_burst}
  is_verified_interaction boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, -- Reviewer had a completed lead or demo with the teacher
  teacher_reply text, -- Public reply by the teacher
  teacher_replied_at timestamptz, -- Reply time
  reply_status text CHECK (reply_status IN ('pending','published','rejected')), -- Replies are moderated too
  edited_at timestamptz, -- Last edit by the author (edits send the review back to pending)
  moderated_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Last moderator
  moderated_at timestamptz, -- Last moderation time
  rejection_reason_code text, -- e.g. CONTACT_DETAILS, ABUSIVE, NOT_A_TEACHING_EXPERIENCE
  published_at timestamptz, -- First published
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Created
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), -- Updated
  deleted_at timestamptz -- Soft delete (author deleted it or account deleted)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_teacher_reviews_author ON teacher_reviews (teacher_id, author_user_id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_reviews_queue ON teacher_reviews (status, created_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_teacher_reviews_teacher ON teacher_reviews (teacher_id, status, published_at DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_teacher_reviews_updated BEFORE UPDATE ON teacher_reviews FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at();

Module 34 · Institute Reviews

Phase 9 · Reviews · Depends on: M22, M28, M31 (M35 moderates, M27 consumes) · Owns tables: institute_reviews · Reads: institutes, app_users, leads · Build estimate: 2 days

1. Module Overview

Reviews of institutes by parents and students: overall stars, optional aspect ratings (teaching, infrastructure, value, safety), text, verified-interaction flag and the institute manager's reply. Same list/summary/cache behaviour as Module 33, feeding the Student Feedback criterion of institute ratings (Module 27).

2. Business Purpose

Families share experiences of coaching centres widely; capturing them on-platform, moderated, gives the Student Feedback score real data and gives parents honest signals.

3. User Stories

  • As Verification Admin, I want an institute's review average and aspect scores before I rate it so that my Student Feedback score is grounded.
  • As Support Admin, I want to see an institute's replies to reviews so that I can check they are professional.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-34.1 Rules. As FR-33.1 with: interaction = a lead or campus-visit demo with the institute; aspect ratings optional 1–5 each for teaching, infrastructure, value, safety; replies written by the institute's manager or counsellors (moderated).

FR-34.2 Rating cache. On publish/unpublish, recompute institutes.user_rating_avg and user_rating_count; mark the institute's current rating as "feedback changed" if the average moves by ≥ 0.3 since the rating was submitted (shown as a hint to raters).

FR-34.3 Lists and summary. GET /institute-reviews, GET /institutes/:id/reviews, GET /institutes/:id/reviews/summary (overall, by role, distribution, aspect averages, reply rate, Bayesian average /10 used by Module 27).

5. Validation Rules

As Module 33 plus aspect filter (teaching, infrastructure, value, safety) and aspectMin 1–5.

Module 35 · Review Moderation

Phase 9 · Reviews · Depends on: M33, M34 · Owns tables: review_flags, review_moderation_logs · Reads: teacher_reviews, institute_reviews · Build estimate: 4 days

1. Module Overview

One moderation workspace for teacher and institute reviews and their replies: an approval queue for pending items, a flagged queue (user reports and automated flags), spam detection with scores and reasons, and actions — approve, reject with a reason code, flag, hide, restore. Every decision is logged and updates rating caches and trust scores.

2. Business Purpose

Fake, abusive or contact-sharing reviews destroy trust and can move money off-platform. Moderation must be fast (target: pending reviews decided within 24 hours), consistent (reason codes) and explainable (log of every decision).

3. User Stories

  • As Support Admin, I want a queue of pending reviews with spam scores so that I approve clean ones in one click and look closely at risky ones.
  • As Support Admin, I want to reject a review with a reason the reviewer sees so that they can rewrite it within the rules.
  • As Support Admin, I want to handle reviews reported by teachers ("this parent never took a class") with the evidence in view.
  • As Super Admin, I want to see which moderator decided each review so that decisions can be reviewed.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-35.1 Auto-moderation pipeline (on create/edit, in a job):

Rule Flag Effect
Phone number, email, UPI id or URL in text contact_info Spam score +0.6; never auto-publish
Same text (≥ 90 % similarity) as another review in 30 days repeated_text +0.4
≥ 5 reviews for one teacher within 24 h from accounts < 7 days old rating_burst +0.4; also raises a trust anomaly (M36)
Profanity / slurs (Hindi + English lists) abusive_language +0.5
Reviewer shares device/IP with the teacher self_review +0.8
No verified interaction unverified +0.2
Score clipped to 0–1. If score < 0.15 and no flags → published automatically (auto_approved); ≥ 0.85 → flagged (auto_flagged); else stays pending.

FR-35.2 Queues. GET /review-moderation/queue?type=teacher|institute|all&tab=pending|flagged|replies|reported — ordered oldest first; each item includes the review, author history (reviews count, rejected count), teacher/institute, flags, open reports.

FR-35.3 Decisions. POST /review-moderation/:reviewType/:reviewId/approve, /reject { reasonCode, note }, /flag { note }, /hide { reasonCode, note } (published → hidden, e.g., legal request), /restore { note } (hidden/rejected → published). Replies: same endpoints with /reply/approve and /reply/reject. Each decision writes review_moderation_logs, updates the review (moderated_by, moderated_at, rejection_reason_code, published_at on first publish), recomputes rating caches (M33/M34) and enqueues trust recalculation (teacher reviews).

Reason codes: CONTACT_DETAILS, ABUSIVE, NOT_A_TEACHING_EXPERIENCE, FAKE_OR_PAID, DUPLICATE, PERSONAL_INFORMATION, LEGAL_REQUEST, OTHER.

FR-35.4 Reports (flags). Users and teachers report reviews in the app (review_flags, one per reporter per review). Three open reports move a published review to flagged (still visible until decided — setting reviews.hide_when_flagged, default false). POST /review-flags/:id/resolve { outcome: upheld|dismissed, note }; upholding a report on a published review requires choosing hide or reject.

FR-35.5 Bulk actions. Select up to 50 items → approve or reject with one reason. Each item is processed and logged individually; the response lists per-item results.

FR-35.6 Notifications. Reviewer: published / rejected (with reason text). Teacher/institute: new published review, and reply approved/rejected.

FR-35.7 Analytics. GET /review-moderation/stats?from&to — volume by status, auto-approval rate, median time to decision, rejections by reason, per-moderator decisions.

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
reviewType teacher, institute
reasonCode list above; required for reject/hide
note 0–500 chars (shown to reviewer on reject when shareNote = true)
outcome upheld, dismissed
bulk ids 1–50 unique ids of the same review type and current status
State rules approve: pending/flagged → published; reject: pending/flagged → rejected; hide: published → hidden; restore: hidden/rejected → published; flag: published/pending → flagged

review_flags

Reports raised against a review by users or teachers.

CREATE TABLE review_flags (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  review_type text NOT NULL CHECK (review_type IN ('teacher','institute')), -- Which review table
  review_id uuid NOT NULL, -- teacher_reviews.id or institute_reviews.id (polymorphic; integrity enforced in the service)
  reporter_user_id uuid REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Who reported
  reason text NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('fake','abusive','personal_details','off_topic','spam','other')), -- Reason
  details text, -- Optional details
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','upheld','dismissed')), -- Outcome
  resolved_by uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- Moderator
  resolved_at timestamptz, -- When resolved
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- Created
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_review_flags_reporter ON review_flags (review_type, review_id, reporter_user_id) WHERE reporter_user_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX idx_review_flags_open ON review_flags (status, created_at) WHERE status = 'open';
CREATE INDEX idx_review_flags_review ON review_flags (review_type, review_id);

review_moderation_logs

Every moderation decision on reviews and replies.

CREATE TABLE review_moderation_logs (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), -- Primary key
  review_type text NOT NULL CHECK (review_type IN ('teacher','institute')), -- Which review table
  review_id uuid NOT NULL, -- Review id
  target text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'review' CHECK (target IN ('review','reply')), -- Review text or the reply
  action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('approved','rejected','flagged','unflagged','hidden','restored','auto_flagged','auto_approved')), -- Decision
  from_status text, -- Before
  to_status text, -- After
  reason_code text, -- e.g. CONTACT_DETAILS
  note text, -- Moderator note
  admin_id uuid REFERENCES admins(id), -- NULL for automated actions
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now() -- When
);
CREATE INDEX idx_review_moderation_logs_review ON review_moderation_logs (review_type, review_id, created_at DESC);

Module 36 · Teacher Trust Score

Phase 10 · Trust Score Engine · Depends on: M16, M17, M33, M35 (complaints factor needs M43; until then it defaults to 100) · Owns tables: trust_score_weights, trust_scores · Reads: teachers, teacher_documents, teacher_reviews, complaints · Build estimate: 4–5 days

1. Module Overview

Calculates each teacher's Trust Score (0–100) from six factors — Aadhaar verification, PAN verification, certificate verification, reviews, complaints and profile completeness — using versioned weights. Scores update automatically on relevant events and nightly. Admins can view the breakdown, change weights (new version, full recalculation), freeze a score during an investigation, or override it temporarily with a reason.

2. Business Purpose

The trust score is shown prominently on every teacher profile and search card. It must be explainable (every point traceable to a factor), stable (not gamed by a burst of reviews), and controllable (weights tunable without code).

3. User Stories

  • As Verification Admin, I want to see how a teacher's 94 is made up so that I can explain it to them.
  • As Super Admin, I want to change factor weights and see the effect on the score distribution before activating so that I don't shock the marketplace.
  • As Support Admin, I want to freeze a teacher's score while a fraud complaint is investigated so that it can't be inflated.
  • As Super Admin, I want to override a score for 30 days with a reason when data is temporarily wrong.

4. Functional Requirements & Business Logic

FR-36.1 Factors (each 0–100).

Factor Default weight Calculation
Aadhaar verification 20 current Aadhaar document: approved 100 · submitted 50 · re-upload requested 25 · rejected/missing 0
PAN verification 10 same mapping for PAN
Certificate verification 20 education certificates: ≥ 1 approved = 70, + 15 if ≥ 2 approved, + 15 if a professional certificate is approved (cap 100); none approved but submitted = 30
Reviews 25 Bayesian-smoothed rating of published reviews: R = (C·m + Σr)/(C + n) with C = 10, m = 4.0; factor = round((R − 1) / 4 × 100); with 0 reviews factor = 60
Complaints 15 100 − 35 × upheld complaints in the last 12 months − 10 × open high/critical complaints (min 0)
Profile completeness 10 teachers.profile_completeness (Module 17)

FR-36.2 Formula. score = Σ(weight_i × factor_i) / Σ(weight_i), rounded to 2 decimals; the badge-less cap: teachers without is_verified_badge cannot exceed 60. Stored in trust_scores with each factor, the weights version and raw inputs; cached on teachers.trust_score.

FR-36.3 Triggers. Recalculate (debounced 60 s per teacher via BullMQ job id trust:<teacherId>) on: document decision, review published/removed, complaint resolved/opened high/critical, profile change affecting completeness, badge change. Nightly full recalculation at 02:00 IST for all approved teachers (chunked 1,000 per job). Each change that moves the score by ≥ 0.01 writes a trust_score_logs row (Module 37).

FR-36.4 Freeze. POST /trust-scores/:teacherId/freeze { reason } sets is_frozen; recalculations compute but do not publish (logged as freeze skips); unfreeze publishes the latest computed value.

FR-36.5 Override. POST /trust-scores/:teacherId/override { score, reason, expiresAt } (≤ 90 days) sets is_overridden, override_score; score shown = override. A job clears expired overrides (override_expired). DELETE /trust-scores/:teacherId/override removes it early.

FR-36.6 Weights. PUT /trust-weights/draft { weights, reason } — six non-negative integers summing to 100. POST /trust-weights/draft/simulate returns the projected distribution (bands 90+, 80–89, 60–79, <60), mean, and the 20 biggest movers, computed from current factor values (no writes). POST /trust-weights/draft/activate activates the version and queues a full recalculation (weights_changed).

FR-36.7 Views. GET /trust-scores/:teacherId (breakdown with factor explanations and inputs), GET /trust-scores (list with filters, distribution), GET /trust-scores/distribution.

FR-36.8 Anomalies. Signals from Module 35 (rating_burst, self_review) and complaint spikes create anomaly entries shown on the trust page (GET /trust-scores/anomalies) with "Freeze" and "Investigate" actions (investigation = create a complaint case in Module 43 with type fraud).

5. Validation Rules

Field Rule
weights object with exactly keys aadhaar, pan, certificates, reviews, complaints, profile_completeness; integers 0–60; sum = 100
override.score 0–100, 2 decimals
override.expiresAt > now, ≤ now + 90 days
reason 10–500 chars (freeze, override, weights)
